jobs.title: Fixed Maintenance Planner/Expeditor (Round Mountain, NV, US)
jobs.description:
Round Mountain is an open-pit mine located in Nevada, one of the best mining jurisdictions in the world. The mine uses conventional open-pit mining methods and processes ore by mill and heap leach. Kinross began operating the mine in 2003, and it has since become a continuous improvement leader in the Company’s portfolio. Round Mountain poured its 15 millionth ounce in 2018. Round Mountain and the nearby Bald Mountain mine make up Kinross’ Nevada operations. 

The Round Mountain mine is an important contributor to the Nye County economy and, working with local stakeholders, has helped achieve significant improvements in healthcare and education in the area.

Job Summary

Under the direction of the Process Maintenance Planning General Supervisor, the incumbent will provide expediting, planning and staging services to the assigned maintenance areas. Ensures the work is properly planned and scheduled or expedited with trade requirements, stores material, direct purchase material, and specialty service(s) identified on the work order, while continuously aligning daily functions to reflect Kinross’ values. This role integrates maintenance planning, materials coordination, and expediting functions to minimize downtime, improve schedule compliance, and support safe and efficient operations. 

Essential Functions

1. Ability to work closely with maintenance supervisors, operations, warehouse, procurement, and vendors to ensure the right resources are available at the right time to meet production and reliability objectives.
2. Develop detailed job plans for corrective, preventive, and predictive maintenance activities, including labor, materials, tools, permits, and safety requirements. 
3. Ensure work orders are fully planned and ready to execute prior to scheduling
4. Maintain accurate equipment history, job plans, and bills of material in the maintenance management system.
5. Support maintenance planning to align with operational priorities and shutdown schedules.
6. Collaborate with general and execution Supervisors to identify material risks and mitigate schedule impacts and job priority and availability. Including changes in the preventative maintenance schedule necessitated by production and/or maintenance requirements.
7. Create and coordinate one-time job plans, where maintenance work needs to be completed due to operational changes, statutory requirement changes or equipment failures.
8. Liaise with Supply Chain to expedite external parts and contractor labor. Ensure that all direct purchases and contracts for equipment and personnel meet Supply Chain policies and procedures.
9. Liaise with Supply Chain to manage warehouse inventory (new stock requests, min/max levels, critical spares, obsolete inventory).
10. Ensure that parts, specialized tools, equipment, and external labor are immediately available when needed.
11. Prepare and manage maintenance kits for scheduled work, ensuring all required components are available prior to execution.  
12. Support outage and major maintenance planning by ensuring long lead items and specialty services are identified and secured early.
13. Create and maintain work orders and requisitions (materials, equipment, and services) in JDE. 
14. Update and maintain status of work orders in JDE to ensure accurate backlog and history.
15. Participate in the application of Reliability Methodologies for supporting the continuous improvement of maintenance strategies (RCM, RCA, FMECA, etc.) 
16. Ensure that all parts and materials are ordered in a timely manner.
17. Help develop other department personnel to perform duties listed above.
18. Compliance with all company policies and procedures including, but not limited to safety, environmental, confidentiality and code of conduct. 
19. Meets or exceeds established performance expectations set by management.
20. Consistently exercises discretion and judgment in job performance.
21. Works without risk or harm to self and others. 
22. Possession of a valid driver’s license issued by state agency, or must be able to pass driver competency course and exam.
23. Punctuality and regular attendance required.
24. Perform other related functions as assigned by supervisor.

Qualifications and Skill Requirements

1.  Excellent safety and attendance record
2.  Demonstrated experience in maintenance planning, scheduling, materials coordination, or expediting within a mining, industrial, or heavy manufacturing environment.
3.  Two (2) years maintenance planning experience in a Process environment preferred
4.  Strong understanding of process plant or fixed maintenance equipment and workflows.
5.  Proficiency in Microsoft Office
6.  Previous experience using the following software applications: JDE, Xeras (or similar Zero-based budgeting tool
7.  Ability to perform the essential functions of this position
8.  Strong verbal, written, analytical and persuasive skills with the ability to interact effectively with all levels of employees and management
9.  Ability to work independently and also as a member of the overall team. 
10.  Strong communication, organization, and problem solving skills.
11.  Ability to function within the qualifications outlined in the attached physical demands sheets. 

Health, Safety, and Environmental Requirements

•  Adheres to all safety and environmental considerations.
•  Have a strong commitment to safe working practices. 
•  Wears Personal Protective Equipment at all times while in the production environment. 
•  Is alert and observes, corrects, and reports unsafe conditions. 
•  Follows operating procedures and complies with all regulatory requirements.

jobs.title: Driller (Elko, NV, US)
jobs.description:
Bald Mountain is an open-pit mine with a large estimated mineral resource in the largest private mining land package in the U.S. The mine is located in White Pine County, one of the best mining jurisdictions in the world, along the southern extension of the prolific Carlin trend. Bald Mountain and the nearby Round Mountain mine make up Kinross’ Nevada operations. 

Bald Mountain is an important contributor to the economy of northeastern Nevada and maintains a comprehensive environmental strategy including wildlife protection, habitat recovery and education.

Job Description

The incumbent will be responsible for the daily operation of a blast-hole drill in an active mine environment. All work must be completed in a safe and efficient manner while continuously aligning daily functions to reflect Kinross’ values and work in accordance with standard operating procedures.

Job Responsibilities

•    Safely operates drill in accordance with standard operating procedures and supervisor instruction to achieve production goals.
•    Prepares and maintains drilling paperwork, including pre-shift inspections, drill reports, inventory sheets, and sample tags.
•    Perform and document pre-shift inspections and monitors gauges and equipment frequently.
•    Visually inspects work areas for potential hazards and works to correct them or report any problems to supervisor immediately.
•    Maintains accurate log of all bits, hammers, breakdowns, maps, and drill patterns.
•    Drills accurately and efficiently to stake depth.
•    Collect drill-hole samples using proper sampling techniques for laboratory analysis as needed.
•    Ability to maneuver on drill pattern using GPS/dispatch navigation system(s).
•    Connects drill pipe sections using hand tools and power wrenches.
•    Safely operate drill equipment with a high degree of competence, skill and proficiency.
•    Maintains radio contact with co-workers and supervisors for operating and safety instructions.
•    Operate drill support water trucks as needed.
•    Assists the blast crew in blasting functions as needed.
•    Troubleshoot and perform minor maintenance as needed.
•    Meet or exceed established performance expectations set by management.
•    Compliance with all company policies and procedures including but not limited to safety, confidentiality, and environmental policies.
•    Perform other duties as required.

Qualifications and Skill Requirements

•    General background in heavy equipment operation preferred.
•    Minimum three years experience in the operation of blast hole production drill rigs required. Including: Ingersol Rand DML, Atlas Copco DML, Atlas Copco Pit Viper 231, Atlas Copco Pit Viper 271 production drills (3-5 yrs.) required. Sandvik DR560 pre-split drills preferred.
•    A good understanding of DTH and rotary drilling required.
•    Understand single-pass & double-pass (adding steel) to reach planned drill depths.
•    A good understanding of GPS Jigsaw navigation/dispatch system or similar navigation systems.
•    Must be able to work within precise parameters, as holes must be drilled exactly to specifications.
•    Must be cognizant of the condition of the surrounding work area and the performance of the machine being used in order to avoid dangerous situations and maintain good working condition of machinery.
•    Willingness to work in adverse weather conditions required.
•    Must be able to carry out assignments free of constant supervision.
•    Ability to work with others in a team environment.
•    High school diploma or equivalent preferred. Employee must have the ability to read and write instructions, perform simple mathematical calculations, and keep records.
•    Ability to function within the qualifications outlined in the attached physical demands sheet.
•    Punctuality and regular attendance is required.
•    Must be available for shift work, overtime, holidays and weekends.
•    Must be 18 years old and presently authorized to work in the United States on a full time basis.
•    Possession of a valid driver’s license required.

jobs.title: Gerente de proyecto
jobs.description:
Somos OPEMIP
· Operadores Mineros del Perú, somos una empresa netamente Peruana con más de 20 años de experiencia, dedicada a los servicios de Construcción y Mantenimiento de Obras, tanto en el campo de la Minería, como el de la Construcción Civil, nos encontramos en búsqueda de un Gerente de Proyecto.
· Descripción del puesto:
· Es el responsable de la planificación, administración y control de la ejecución del servicio (OTMs), conforme a los planos y especificaciones técnicas del proyecto y cumpliendo los estándares y requisitos del cliente. Es el principal responsable operativo de la ejecución del proyecto, garantizando una administración eficiente de los recursos y liderando al equipo para alcanzar los objetivos. Su labor incluye coordinar las distintas áreas desde la planificación hasta el cierre de cada OTM, con el objetivo de optimizar la rentabilidad mediante la reducción de plazos y la implementación de estándares de gestión que fomenten la mejora continua.
· Formación Académica:
Título Profesional en Ingeniería Civil.
Colegiatura (Habilitado) 5 años de antigüedad.
Título de Maestría en Gerencia de Proyectos.
PMP (Profesional en Gerencia de Proyectos) antigüedad máxima 5 años (deseable).
· Conocimientos básicos:
Herramientas de Planificación: Last Planner, 3WLA, CPM.
Metodologías de Gestión: filosofía Lean, Scrum, Fast track, Agile, Kanban, PMBOK.
Conocimiento en obras de Minería en general.
Capacidad de liderazgo y habilidades blandas (deseable certificación)
Conocimiento en SSO en minería e industria.
Sistema de Gestión SMCV.
· Herramientas / Software:
Dominio AutoCAD / CivilCAD a nivel intermedio/avanzado.
Dominio avanzado de MS Excel.
Dominio de software de S10, PowerCost, Primavera P6, MS Project.
Dominio del método de Valor Ganado (CV, SV, CPI, SPI).
Dominio de programación 3WLA.
· Experiencia profesional:
Homologado y habilitado por SMCV (Deseable).
Experiencia General: 12 años en obras de construcción en minería (obligatorio).
Experiencia Específica: 08 años como residente de obra / jefe de proyecto / Gerente de obra.
Experiencia Similar: 05 años en proyectos similares.
· Funciones del puesto:
Dirección operativa del proyecto, reuniones diarias con el Staff.
Coordinación activa con el área de SSO, QAQC, OT y Admin.
Coordinar con el cliente para alinear la ejecución con sus expectativas.
Identificar y gestionar riesgos operacionales, contractuales y financieros.
Asegurar el cumplimiento del alcance, plazos y presupuesto del proyecto.
Implementar estrategias de optimización de costos y productividad.
Supervisar el desarrollo de las obras civiles misceláneas.
Gestionar la logística de equipos, materiales y personal en el proyecto.
Liderar los requerimientos de recursos del proyecto.
Garantizar la operatividad (física y administrativa) de los equipos.
Resolver problemas técnicos y operativos en coordinación con las áreas involucradas.
Implementar buenas prácticas y metodologías de gestión de proyectos.
Optimizar el uso de recursos y mejorar la eficiencia operativa.
Elaboración del plan de trabajo final y sus modificaciones.
Liderar la elaboración de procedimientos PETS finales y sus modificaciones.
Gestión de la documentación necesaria (permisos, autorizaciones, etc.).
Promover una cultura de seguridad en todo el equipo de trabajo.
Asegurar el cumplimiento de normativas de seguridad y medioambiente en minería.
Liderar reuniones de avance y coordinación con todas las partes interesadas.
Validar los RFIs del proyecto, Valorizaciones, EDP, Cronograma, etc.
Gestionar el envío de información de los avances físicos al área de OT.
Gestionar la elaboración de informes Semanales y Mensuales.
Validación semanal de la planificación Look ahead (3WLA).
Validación del análisis mediante el método de Valor Ganado (informes internos semanales).
Informar periódicamente a la gerencia de proyectos sobre los avances.
· Requisitos:
Indispensable radicar en Arequipa.
Disponibilidad para trabajar en SMCV.
·

jobs.title: Ingeniero de Desempeño y Análisis de Mantenimiento
jobs.description:
Anglo American, en sociedad con la Corporación Mitsubishi, está desarrollando la operación minera Quellaveco, uno de los yacimientos de cobre más grandes del mundo, localizado en la región de Moquegua, al sur del Perú.

Quellaveco tendrá una vida de reservas de 30 años. Utilizará proceso minero de tajo abierto y flotación para producir concentrados de cobre, así como molibdeno y plata como subproductos. Se espera que Quellaveco produzca en promedio 300 mil toneladas de cobre por año en sus primeros 10 años de operación.

En Anglo American nuestra estrategia es asegurar y desarrollar Quellaveco aplicando prácticas y tecnologías innovadoras que confiamos a nuestra gente. Estamos comprometidos a convertirnos en socios para el futuro, operar con seguridad, sustentabilidad y responsabilidad.

En Anglo American nos encontramos en búsqueda de un
Ingeniero de Desempeño y Análisis de Mantenimiento.

Integrar y analizar datos de mantenimiento mecánico y eléctrico de los equipos mineros móviles y de la planta concentradora, identificando tendencias, desviaciones, pérdidas de desempeño y oportunidades de mejora.

Desarrollar análisis de confiabilidad, mantenibilidad y predicción de fallas de los equipos, con el propósito de reducir los riesgos operacionales y maximizar la vida útil de los activos.

Realizar estimaciones de costos de equipos, componentes, repuestos y servicios para sustentar la proyección de presupuestos financieros de mantenimiento e inversiones en el mediano y largo plazo.

Desarrollar y evaluar casos de negocio relacionados con mantenimiento, confiabilidad, renovación de activos y mejoras de ingeniería, incluyendo análisis de rentabilidad y sensibilidad de las principales variables técnicas y económicas.

Desarrollar y revisar análisis de ingeniería asociados con el montaje, precomisionamiento, comisionamiento y puesta en marcha de equipos, asegurando su mantenibilidad, confiabilidad y adecuada transferencia a Operaciones y Mantenimiento.

Establecer indicadores y mecanismos de seguimiento del desempeño y salud de los activos, promoviendo la estandarización y automatización de reportes para la toma de decisiones.

FUNCIONES Y RESPONSABILIDADES SHE:

Conocer y aplicar los valores, principios y la Política SHE de Anglo American Quellaveco y contribuir a su visión de cero daños.

Cumplir y hacer cumplir los requisitos legales y otros compromisos asumidos por Anglo American Quellaveco, los estándares, procedimientos y reglamentos internos del Sistema de Gestión; así como las reuniones de capacitación, concientización y formación de la cultura de Cero Daños.

Asegurar que las medidas de control para los peligros y riesgos de SHE identificados, se encuentren implementadas en el lugar de trabajo, para el desarrollo de una labor segura.

Reportar oportunamente los actos y condiciones inseguras; así como los Incidentes.

Asegurar la mejora continua en la Gestión de Seguridad, Salud Ocupacional y Medio Ambiente.

Profesional titulado en Ingeniería Mecánica, Ingeniería Eléctrica, Ingeniería Industrial o carreras afines.

Colegiado y habilitado (indispensable)

Maestría en Gestión de Activos y/o planeamiento estratégico (deseable)

Licencia de conducir vigente categoría A-I, con antigüedad mínima de dos años desde su emisión (Indispensable)

Certificación o especialización en gestión de activos, confiabilidad, mantenimiento predictivo o gestión de proyectos (deseable)

EXPERIENCIA

Mínimo cinco años de experiencia en el sector minero, de los cuales al menos dos años deben corresponder a posiciones similares de análisis de mantenimiento, confiabilidad, planeamiento o gestión de activos.

Experiencia en mantenimiento de equipos mineros móviles y equipos de plantas concentradoras.

Experiencia en análisis de datos de mantenimiento mecánico y eléctrico, confiabilidad, predicción de fallas y desempeño de activos.

Experiencia en planeamiento de mantenimiento preventivo y estrategias de mantenimiento de mediano y largo plazo.

Experiencia en evaluación de costos, elaboración de presupuestos y análisis técnico-económico de alternativas de mantenimiento o renovación de activos.

Experiencia en proyectos desarrollados desde las etapas de identificación, prefactibilidad y factibilidad hasta la ejecución, comisionamiento y puesta en marcha.

Experiencia en ingeniería de montaje, preparación operacional y transferencia de equipos al área de Mantenimiento (Mina y Planta).

Conocimiento y experiencia en investigación de incidentes.

jobs.title: Commercial & Scientific Analyst/Lead
jobs.description:
About the company

The mining industry has steadily become worse at finding new ore deposits, requiring >10X more capital to make discoveries compared to 30 years ago. The easy-to-find, near-surface deposits have largely been found, and the industry has chronically under-invested in new exploration technology, relying on the manual techniques of yesteryear – even as demand accelerates for copper, lithium, and other metals to build electric vehicles, renewable energy, and data centers.

KoBold builds AI models for mineral exploration and deploys those models—alongside our novel sensors—to guide decisions on KoBold-owned-and-operated exploration programs. Since our founding in 2018, KoBold has become by far both the largest independent mineral exploration company and the largest exploration technology developer. Our data scientists and software engineers, who come from leading technology companies, jointly lead exploration programs with our renowned exploration geologists.

KoBold has proven its first discovery with materially less capital than the industry average and found one of the best copper deposits ever discovered: the copper is far more concentrated than the global average of copper mines, and this asset alone is expected to generate meaningful revenue for decades. KoBold has a portfolio of more than 60 other projects, each of which has the potential for another high-quality discovery.

KoBold is privately held; investors include institutional asset managers T. Rowe Price and Canada Pension Plan Investments; technology venture capitalists Andreessen Horowitz, Breakthrough Energy Ventures, BOND Capital, Durable Capital, StepStone, and Standard Investments; and strategic natural resources companies BHP and Mitsubishi.

We’re hiring a Commercial & Scientific Analyst/Lead to accelerate our mission.

About the position

In this role, you will report to a Lead or Manager within the Commercial Analytics team, and work closely within a remote team of 5 - 7 (across North America and Europe) to structure ambiguous problems, build financial and operational models, and provide recommendations to the C-suite for key decisions.

The work will span a variety of topics and include traditional market analyses such as creating supply/demand forecasts and writing commodity outlook reports, and non-traditional analyses as-needed to advance KoBold’s mission – e.g., operational and financial modeling for KoBold’s exploration programs, build vs. buy decisions for KoBold’s technology, mine economics modeling, and scientific communication materials for external audiences s, to name a few.

This is an ideal role for a recent graduate looking to acquire a wide range of skills very quickly. The learning curve will be steep, and the work will be varied and intellectually demanding.

Responsibilities

The Commercial & Scientific Analyst/Lead will:

Aggregate existing research and/or conduct original research to build forecasts and models related to commodity markets, KoBold operations, mine development, and more

Work with the Commercial Analytics and Financial Planning & Analysis team to answer strategic questions from leadership

Prepare materials for the Board of Directors and investors or partners

Use a first-principles approach in collaboration with various KoBold functions to help make decisions or improve operational efficiency (e.g., cost models for technology, HR, exploration programs, carbon emissions reporting, trade-off/sensitivity analyses)

Conduct analytics for critical workstreams in mine development and exploration

Build and maintain financial models assessing project economics

Support others on the Commercial Analytics team on various analytical assignments

Qualifications

A great candidate will have:

Education in a STEM discipline or economics (physics, chemistry, astronomy/astrophysics, or mathematics is preferred)

At least 1 year of experience in technology, natural resources, finance, or professional services

Experience with Python or other scientific computing language and/or financial modeling

Excitement about working on a wide array of problems

Excellent communication and organizational skills

Regardless of formal training, a strong orientation toward thinking from first principles with respect to science, technology, economics, and business

Work practices and motivation:

Demonstrated ability to quickly absorb and synthesize complex information, with a keen eye for detail and intellectual rigor

Exceptional curiosity and eagerness to learn, with a proactive approach to exploring new concepts and technologies

Excitement about joining a fast-growing early-stage company, comfort with a dynamic work environment, and eagerness to take on a range of responsibilities

Ability to independently prioritize multiple tasks effectively

What to Expect

Joining KoBold means getting the opportunity for hands-on exposure to our exploration projects around the world. All employees are expected to travel to project sites, with a minimum of one week per year. Field-facing and technical roles spend significantly more time in the field.

KoBold Metals is an equal opportunity workplace and an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunities for people of any race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, marital status, national origin, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, or veteran status.

This position is full-time, exempt.

The US base salary range for this full-time exempt position is $105,000 - $190,000 + 401K and equity.

Location: KoBold is a remote first workplace, we are open to candidates currently residing anywhere in the United States, Canada, or United Kingdom. All candidates must be authorized to legally work in either the United States, Canada, or United Kingdom.

jobs.title: Data Scientist - (Global)
jobs.description:
Data Scientist (Senior Staff, Staff, & Senior roles available)

About the company

KoBold Metals is a mineral exploration company using AI to explore for the metals we need for our transition to a low-carbon economy. KoBold’s business is discovering, defining, expanding, and developing mineral resources, and KoBold’s objective is to achieve a step-change improvement in exploration success: we aim to discover more tier 1 resources, faster, and with fewer failures.

KoBold has a global portfolio of more than 80 exploration properties targeting nickel, copper, cobalt, and lithium, which range from 100%-owned to partnerships with both majors, junior explorers, and prospectors.

Our team includes the best of the industry in exploration geoscience, data science, software engineering, operations, and business personnel. Prior to joining KoBold, KoBold team members have made nearly 20 discoveries. Our exploration programs are co-led by our geoscientists and data scientists, who develop exploration hypotheses, rigorously quantify uncertainty in our understanding of the subsurface, and design data collection programs that most effectively reduce uncertainty, drawing upon a large suite of proprietary exploration technology built by our data scientists and software engineers. Our field programs validate and improve the system and have demonstrated material improvements over conventional exploration methods

jobs.title: Director of Mineral Processing
jobs.description:
Director of Mineral Processing

About the Company

The mining industry has steadily become worse at finding new ore deposits, requiring >10X more capital to make discoveries compared to 30 years ago. The easy-to-find, near-surface deposits have largely been found, and the industry has chronically under-invested in new exploration technology, relying on the manual techniques of yesteryear – even as demand accelerates for copper, lithium, and other metals to build electric vehicles, renewable energy, and data centers.

KoBold builds AI models for mineral exploration and deploys those models—alongside our novel sensors—to guide decisions on KoBold-owned-and-operated exploration programs. Since our founding in 2018, KoBold has become by far both the largest independent mineral exploration company and the largest exploration technology developer. Our data scientists and software engineers, who come from leading technology companies, jointly lead exploration programs with our renowned exploration geologists.

KoBold has proven its first discovery with materially less capital than the industry average and found one of the best copper deposits ever discovered: the copper is far more concentrated than the global average of copper mines, and this asset alone is expected to generate meaningful revenue for decades. KoBold has a portfolio of more than 60 other projects, each of which has the potential for another high-quality discovery.

KoBold is privately held; investors include institutional asset managers T. Rowe Price and Canada Pension Plan Investments; technology venture capitalists Andreessen Horowitz, Breakthrough Energy Ventures, BOND Capital, Durable Capital, StepStone, and Standard Investments; and strategic natural resources companies BHP and Mitsubishi.

About the Role

The Mineral Processing Lead will contribute to and lead the development and execution of mineral processing strategy across KoBold’s portfolio, with an initial focus on the Mingomba copper project in Zambia. Reporting to the CTO, this role is responsible for all aspects of process engineering from early-stage metallurgical testwork through feasibility study design and operational readiness. You will define the flowsheet, drive geometallurgical characterization, evaluate processing routes (concentration, hydrometallurgy, smelting), and ensure that mineral processing considerations are integrated into mine planning and economic modeling from the earliest stages.

Responsibilities

Process Engineering & Flowsheet Development

Own the process flowsheet design for Mingomba and future KoBold projects, from scoping through feasibility.

Work hands on and with your team to define and manage metallurgical testwork programs: comminution characterization, flotation optimization, hydrometallurgical evaluation, and pilot-scale campaigns.

Evaluate and recommend processing routes including froth flotation to concentrate, SX-EW, pressure oxidation, and smelter/refinery toll arrangements. Quantify the economic trade-offs of each.

Develop process design criteria, mass and water balances, and equipment specifications for feasibility-level engineering.

Lead the assessment of tailings characteristics, reprocessing potential, and environmental implications of process residues.

Geometallurgy & Integration

Build and maintain a geometallurgical framework that links ore variability (mineralogy, texture, grade distribution) to processing performance with first principles and statistical models.

Collaborate with geologists and data scientists to integrate geometallurgical statistics into resource models, mine schedules, and economic analyses.

Define sampling protocols for metallurgical characterization of drill core and ensure adequate coverage of ore variability.

Ensure mineral processing assumptions are reflected in techno-economic models including TC/RC structures, payable metal calculations, and concentrate penalty elements.

Technical Leadership & Team Building

Build, lead, and mentor a mineral processing function within KoBold’s Advanced Technology Group.

Direct and manage relationships with metallurgical consultants, contract laboratories, and engineering firms.

Serve as one of KoBold’s internal experts and external representatives on mineral processing for investor presentations, partner discussions, and technical reviews.

Contribute to feasibility study management and preparation of technical reports (NI 43-101 / JORC-compliant as applicable).

Identify and evaluate emerging processing technologies relevant to KoBold’s target commodities (copper, lithium, nickel, cobalt) along with the existing team.

Cross-functional Collaboration

Work with mine engineers to optimize cut-off grade strategies and ore scheduling based on processing constraints.

Partner with KoBold’s data science team to apply machine learning and statistical methods to metallurgical datasets.

Coordinate with business development and commercial teams on offtake strategy, concentrate marketing, and smelter negotiations.

Support environmental and permitting workstreams with process-related inputs on water use, reagent consumption, emissions, and waste management.

Qualifications

Required

15+ years of experience with large scale (ton-kton / day) chemical processes

Quantitative, statistical, and scientific rigor, including execution of experimental designs to optimize multistage processing of complex feedstocks

Experience with design/build from lab test work through large scale production

Track record of managing consultants, laboratories, and multidisciplinary technical teams

Strong technical writing skills, including preparation of technical reports

Willingness to travel to project sites in Zambia and other KoBold locations (estimated 20–30%).

Preferred

Experience in mineral processing, with significant time spent on copper sulfide projects from testwork through to operating plant design or commissioning.

Direct experience leading metallurgical test

KoBold has a portfolio of more than 60 other projects, each of which has the potential for another high-quality discovery.

KoBold is privately held; investors include institutional asset managers T. Rowe Price and Canada Pension Plan Investments; technology venture capitalists Andreessen Horowitz, Breakthrough Energy Ventures, BOND Capital, Durable Capital, StepStone, and Standard Investments; and strategic natural resources companies BHP and Mitsubishi.

About the role:

At KoBold, we believe making mineral exploration data broadly accessible to humans and machines will enable systematic exploration and materially improved exploration success rates. This role is a key ingredient to this strategy. As an early Engineering Manager on the Data Systems Engineering team, you will have the opportunity to shape how we build our product and organization to realize this vision. Through development of our robust data systems, we will empower KoBold to unlock invaluable insights and streamline intricate scientific processes. Collaborating with our exceptional team of data scientists and geologists, you will have the opportunity to tackle complex scientific problems head-on and collectively pave the way for the discoveries of vital energy transition metals like lithium, copper, nickel, and cobalt. Together we can shape the future of mineral exploration and contribute to building a sustainable world.

Responsibilities of this role include:

Thoughtfully build and lead a team of high-performing software engineers, hiring and growing diverse individuals on your team

Leverage your team in collaboration with data scientists, geoscientists, and other software engineers to plan, prioritize, and deliver impactful projects that accelerate our exploration efforts

Work with the Head of Data Systems Engineering and interdisciplinary leaders across the company on our strategy to advance both our technical product and organization

Collaborate with cross functional peers (geoscientists and data scientists) across the company, learning about mineral exploration. Coach your team to better partner across the company.

Spend roughly 1/3rd of your time contributing to projects as an individual contributor

Qualifications

Our ideal candidate will have:

8+ years experience building production software systems

3+ years in an engineering leadership role with reports

Experience building robust distributed cloud data systems. Bonus for experience building systems managing large geospatial or geoscientific datasets.

Deep understanding of multiple database and data storage technologies

A track record of taking ownership from definition of the problem and delivering large projects with demonstrated impact in an iterative manner

Skilled at dealing with ambiguity and prioritizing effectively from multiple inputs

Formal education or job exposure to natural sciences

Work practices and motivation:

Intellectual curiosity and eagerness to learn about all aspects of mineral exploration, particularly in the geology domain. Open to working directly with geologists in the field across the world. Enjoys constantly learning such that you are driving insights through using our tools in exploration.

Ability to explain technical problems to and collaborate on solutions with domain experts who are not software developers. A strong communicator who enjoys working with colleagues across the company.

Excitement about joining a fast-growing early-stage company, comfort with a dynamic work environment, and eagerness to take on an evolving range of responsibilities.

Keen not just to build cool technology, but to figure out what technical product to build to best achieve the business objectives of the company.

What to Expect

Joining KoBold means getting the opportunity for hands-on exposure to our exploration projects around the world. All employees are expected to travel to project sites, with a minimum of one week per year. Field-facing and technical roles spend significantly more time in the field.

KoBold Metals is an equal opportunity workplace and an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity for people of any race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, marital status, national origin, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, or veteran status.

The US base salary range for this full-time exempt position is $200,000-$240,000.

Location: Remote, Candidates can be located anywhere in the United States or Canada. All candidates must be legally authorized to work in the United States or Canada.

About the Role

We're looking for a sharp, systems-minded Executive Assistant to support our Chief Investment Officer based in London, and 2 VPs (one in London and one in South Africa). You'll be embedded in a fast-moving, Slack-first culture where things change quickly, and attention to detail is the difference between smooth and chaotic. You'll be trusted with sensitive information and high-visibility communications that touch every employee at KoBold.

We take hiring seriously, because we're building a team, not just filling a seat. If you move forward, you'll complete a timed written assessment designed to test your judgment, resourcefulness, and communication under pressure. From there, you'll interview with our EA team and, if you advance, with the executives you'd be supporting directly. We're a remote company, which means communication and collaboration aren't nice-to-haves. They're the foundation of how we operate. Our EA team is tight-knit and genuinely invested in each other's success, and we're looking for someone who will add to that, not just show up and do their own thing. The process takes time by design. We want to make sure this is the right fit for you as much as it is for us.

Responsibilities

Executive Support

Own complex, frequently shifting calendars for two busy executives

Coordinate meetings across time zones; manage last-minute changes without losing composure

Arrange domestic and international travel including flights, hotels, and ground transport, and handle changes quickly

Prepare agendas and briefing materials so executives walk into every meeting ready

Take notes and track follow-ups when requested

Handle expense reports, approvals, and administrative tasks with speed and accuracy

Triage inbound requests and route communications through Slack and other tools

Qualifications

You're the kind of EA who doesn't need to be told what to do twice and doesn't need hand-holding to get things done. You can operate independently, manage competing priorities, and make smart judgment calls on your own. At the same time, you know that great EA work is a team sport. You're a natural collaborator who shows up for the broader EA team, shares context freely, and pitches in when someone else needs support.

You communicate with precision: short, clear, no fluff, because you know everyone around you is busy. You're a natural relationship-builder who earns trust quickly and protects it fiercely. You treat sensitive information like it was your own.

You bring positive energy to every collaboration and have a natural ability to motivate and enthuse the people around you, even when the work is demanding or the timeline is tight. You have a sunny disposition that's genuinely yours. You understand that you're often the messenger in the middle, and you don't take a curt Slack reply personally.

Minimum Qualifications

Based in London (close to Shoreditch is a plus!)

7+ years supporting senior executives, ideally two or more simultaneously, in a fast-moving environment

Exceptional organizational and project management skills; you've owned multi-step workflows with multiple stakeholders before

Flawless attention to detail; you're the person who catches the typo in the deck title

Comfortable in real-time communication tools (Slack preferred) and quick to learn new systems

Already experimenting with AI, or excited to learn

Professional, discreet, and unflappable under pressure

Available evenings and weekends when the situation calls for it

A genuine team player who collaborates well with other EAs and pitches in beyond your immediate scope when needed

We'd love for the right opportunity to bring you to KoBold someday. If you don't yet meet the minimum qualifications for this role, we'd encourage you to hold off and apply when the timing is right. Because our applicant tracking system retains application history, submitting before you're a strong match could affect how your profile is viewed for future roles. We'd much rather see you apply when you're set up to shine!

Preferred

Experience supporting U.S.-based executives or working in an American high-growth company

Familiar with executives who work across evenings and weekends when necessary

Your work will empower KoBold to unlock invaluable insights and streamline intricate scientific processes. Collaborating with our exceptional team of data scientists, geologists, and other software engineers, you will have the opportunity to tackle complex problems head-on and collectively pave the way for the discoveries of vital energy transition metals like lithium, copper, nickel, and cobalt. In this role, you will develop state of the art instruments to collect data to guide our exploration programs. You will simulate, characterize, and calibrate sensor performance and design new data acquisition systems. Working with vendors and partners, you will build hardware and work with our operations staff to deploy it in the field.

With this sensor data and other data sources at KoBold, you will build models and apply a wide range of scientific computing, statistical, and physics-based methods to find places where there is evidence of ore-forming processes at work and to predict the locations of ore-grade mineralization in 2D and 3D. You will be creating models and developing software to accelerate discovery of critical battery metals.

Working with your geoscience colleagues, you will identify new opportunities and technologies for geophysical data collection, create 2D and 3D geologic predictions, identify exploration targets, design field programs to collect data, and use that data to reduce the uncertainty in our predictions and guide the next phase of field work.

Ultimately, your role is to help KoBold make valuable discoveries by building and deploying next generation hardware and using data tools to solve scientific problems. As one of the early members of this team, you will help build these tools from the ground up.

Design, develop, and deploy new mineral exploration data collection instruments and methods.

Find and curate a wide variety of geospectral, geophysical, geochemical, geologic, and geographic data and integrate it into KoBold’s proprietary data system.

Build models to make statistically valid predictions about the locations of compositional anomalies within the Earth’s crust.

Create effective visualizations for evaluating model performance and enabling rapid interaction with the underlying data and key features.

jobs.description:
Data Scientist

About the company

KoBold Metals is a mineral exploration company using AI to explore for the metals we need for our transition to a low-carbon economy. KoBold’s business is discovering, defining, expanding, and developing mineral resources, and KoBold’s objective is to achieve a step-change improvement in exploration success: we aim to discover more tier 1 resources, faster, and with fewer failures.

KoBold has a global portfolio of more than 50 exploration properties targeting nickel, copper, cobalt, and lithium, which range from 100%-owned to partnerships with both majors, junior explorers, and prospectors.

Our team includes the best of the industry in exploration geoscience, data science, software engineering, operations, and business personnel. Prior to joining KoBold, KoBold team members have made nearly 20 discoveries. Our exploration programs are co-led by our geoscientists and data scientists, who develop exploration hypotheses, rigorously quantify uncertainty in our understanding of the subsurface, and design data collection programs that most effectively reduce uncertainty, drawing upon a large suite of proprietary exploration technology built by our data scientists and software engineers. Our field programs validate and improve the system and have demonstrated material improvements over conventional exploration methods

KoBold is privately held; investors include institutional asset managers T. Rowe Price and Canada Pension Plan Investments; technology venture capitalists Andreessen Horowitz, Breakthrough Energy Ventures, BOND Capital, Durable Capital, StepStone, and Standard Investments; and strategic natural resources companies BHP and Mitsubishi.

We are hiring Data Scientists to help accelerate our mission.

About the position

In this role, you will build predictive models and apply a wide range of scientific computing, statistical, and physics-based methods to find places where there is evidence of ore-forming processes at work and to predict the locations of ore-grade mineralization in 2D and 3D. You will help build a worldwide dataset that underlies our exploration program, with careful attention to identifying and quantifying uncertainty in the data and in our predictions. You will create models and develop software to accelerate discovery of critical battery metals.

You will join an outstanding team of data scientists and engineers and will work closely with KoBold’s world-renowned geoscientists to incorporate our best understanding of the chemical and physical processes that create ore deposits. Working with your geoscience colleagues, you will create 2D and 3D geologic predictions, identify exploration targets, design field programs to collect data, and use that data to reduce the uncertainty in our predictions and guide the next phase of field work.

Ultimately, your role is to help KoBold make valuable discoveries by building data tools to solve scientific problems. As one of the early members of this team, you will help build these tools from the ground up.

Responsibilities

The Data Scientist will:

Help develop KoBold’s proprietary software exploration tools.

Find and curate geophysical, geochemical, geologic, and geographic data and integrate it into KoBold’s proprietary data system.

Build models to make statistically valid predictions about the locations of compositional anomalies within the Earth’s crust.

Create effective visualizations for evaluating model performance and enabling rapid interaction with the underlying data and key features.

Present to and collaborate with our external partners and stakeholders.

Technical skills, including extensive experience with:

Cloud computing resources.

Building predictive models, applying them to different problems, and evaluating and interpreting the results.

KoBold has proven its first discovery with materially less capital than the industry average and found one of the best copper deposits ever discovered: the copper is far more concentrated than the global average of copper mines, and this asset alone is expected to generate meaningful revenue for decades. KoBold has a portfolio of more than 60 other projects, each of which has the potential for another high-quality discovery.

KoBold is privately held; investors include institutional asset managers T. Rowe Price and Canada Pension Plan Investments; technology venture capitalists Andreessen Horowitz, Breakthrough Energy Ventures, BOND Capital, Durable Capital, StepStone, and Standard Investments; and strategic natural resources companies BHP and Mitsubishi.

About the Role

In this role, you will perform full cycle accounting for assigned DRC entities. In addition to owning the day-to-day accounting and month-end close for the assigned DRC entities, you will independently manage statutory audits and regulatory compliance. You will provide support to field exploration teams and vendors. Since KoBold is a startup company, your role will be dynamic and your role and responsibilities will grow as the company grows.

Responsibilities

Perform full-cycle accounting and financial reporting.
Manage end-to-end accounting for assigned DRC entities, including monthly close, reconciliations, and variance analysis. Prepare and review journal entries including payroll, and ensure the integrity of the general ledger on an ongoing basis.

Ensure compliance with DRC tax, accounting, and mining legislation.
Support accurate and timely compliance with DRC direct and indirect tax obligations (monthly VAT, WHT filings), mining-specific levies, and SYSCOHADA statutory reporting requirements. Prepare SYCOHADA and CPCC compliant statutory financial statements and coordinate with local advisors and regulatory bodies as needed to meet filing deadlines and maintain good standing.

Manage external audits and relationships with authorities.
Serve as the primary point of contact for external auditors (ONEC certified DRC auditors and Holding company auditors in South Africa) and local regulatory bodies for assigned entities, ensuring timely responses, proper documentation, and effective resolution of audit findings.

Support field exploration and FP&A teams.
Collaborate cross-functionally with field exploration and financial planning teams on project expense reporting and analysis, including review of petty cash reconciliations, to ensure accurate and timely financial information for operational decision-making.

Build and scale accounting operations.
Implement and maintain new processes as the company grows, proactively identifying opportunities to improve efficiency and enable the accounting function to scale as entity scope and complexity increase.

Handle sensitive information with confidentiality and strong ethics.
Demonstrate commitment to ethical business practices and full compliance with all applicable accounting rules, reporting requirements, and anti-corruption laws, maintaining the highest standards of professional integrity.

Qualifications

The candidate must have:

Bachelor's degree in Accounting, or equivalent certification

7+ years experience in accounting, with mining industry experience preferred

Experience working with multiple currencies

Strong knowledge of SYSCOHADA, IFRS & US GAAP

Fluency in both French and English, written and spoken

Strong organizational skills and attention to detail

Ability to quickly learn new tools as needed and solve new problems continuously

A high degree of independence and the ability to work effectively with limited supervision

Flexibility to accommodate meetings with staff/vendors overseas

Experience interfacing with DRC regulatory bodies including DGI, CPCC, ARSP

Interest in learning about mineral exploration and being a close partner to the exploration project teams

What to Expect

Joining KoBold means getting the opportunity for hands-on exposure to our exploration projects around the world. All employees are expected to travel to project sites, with a minimum of one week per year. Field-facing and technical roles spend significantly more time in the field.

KoBold Metals is an equal opportunity workplace and an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity for people of any race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, marital status, national origin, age, citizenship, disability, or veteran status.

This position is Full Time.

At this time, we are only accepting applications from Congolese nationals.

(Location: Lubumbashi, DRC)

jobs.description:
About the Company:

KoBold Metals Zambia Limited is a Zambian-led company exploring for the ore deposits that will become the next generation of new mines in Zambia.

KoBold Metals Zambia is the Zambian affiliate of KoBold Metals, a U.S.-based company exploring around the world for battery metals using proprietary AI to guide exploration decisions. Our business is discovering, defining, expanding, and developing mineral resources, and our objective is to achieve a step-change improvement in exploration success, resulting in more tier 1 resources discovered faster, with fewer failures, and with far less exploration capital.

KoBold is privately held; investors include institutional asset managers T. Rowe Price and Canada Pension Plan Investments; technology venture capitalists Andreessen Horowitz, Breakthrough Energy Ventures, BOND Capital, Durable Capital, StepStone, and Standard Investments; and strategic natural resources companies BHP and Mitsubishi.

KoBold Metals Zambia is building a rapidly growing team of Zambian geologists, operators, and executives to identify, acquire, explore, and develop exploration opportunities and mineral resources drawing upon KoBold’s technology and the expertise of colleagues worldwide.

About the job:

The Senior UG Mine Engineer will lead the mine design efforts for KoBold’s Mingomba project, including pre-feasibility and feasibility engineering studies. You will help to identify, design, and execute all mining engineering programs necessary to maximize the safety, feasibility, and value of our future mine. In addition, you will be responsible for the strategy, implementation and execution of mine design strategies consistent with development plans and in coordination with operations teams. You will also support all modeling work from district to mine scales in support of these goals. You will be responsible for building and fostering a collaborative relationship to support synergies with surrounding operators.

You will join an outstanding team of geoscientists, data scientists, and software engineers. You will be a core part of the project teams, supporting the advancement of the science and practice of exploration. You will support the development of novel data collection and monitoring programs. Working closely with geologists, hydrogeologists, and data scientists you will support construction of physics-based and data-driven models of the hydrogeology of our exploration sites and state-of-the-art water management strategies. A key challenge will be to quantify uncertainties relevant to mining, and to identify efficient means for reducing these uncertainties as the project advances.

Senior UG Mine Engineer

Conduct or support a full range of mine engineering functions, including:

Detailed design of Mingomba underground mine

Engineering trade-off studies

Cost estimation and economic analysis of alternatives

Preparation of technical documents including public disclosure documents for Mineral Resources and Reserves

Provide feedback to geological and geotechnical modeling as necessary.

Support both surface and underground facilities engineering

Apply KoBold’s Project Management standards to manage all aspects of projects

Work collaboratively across engineering disciplines and technical staff to develop the skills and procedures needed to effectively deliver mining engineering assignments

Serve as an internal technical resource and provide guidance and mentorship to junior-level staff.

Identify, develop, and follow through on value engineering opportunities

Mentor staff to support their growth and professional development.

Exercise responsible and ethical decision-making regarding company resources and conduct and adhere to KoBold’s Code of Conduct and related policies and procedures.

Perform additional responsibilities as required by business needs.

Qualifications and skills:

Bachelor’s Degree in Mining Engineering, or closely related discipline.

Minimum of 7 years relevant post qualification experience in engineering with an emphasis on underground mine planning, design and scheduling.

EIZ Certification (Preferred).

Experience working with multiple consultants within the mining industry.

Strong technical writing skills with experience writing technical reports.

Strong organizational, analytical, and strategic planning skills

Experience utilizing mine planning, design and scheduling software packages such as MineScape, MineSight 3D, Vulcan, Surpac, Deswik, Datamine, Gemcom, Mine 2-4D, and EPS

Effective interpersonal and communication skills when interacting with others, expressing intricate ideas effectively and professionally to an engineering and non-engineering audience.

Strong self-leadership and interpersonal communication skills with the ability to effectively, persuasively, and tactfully interact with clients, regulators, project managers, and employees at all levels of the organization.

Ability to work independently and provide guidance and leadership to junior team or project members, with strict adherence to QA/QC.

Experienced with providing critical review for documents and preparing technical deliverables and plans with a high degree of complexity.

Ability to assertively direct others in the field such as subcontractors, drillers, and others to consistently complete tasks safely and efficiently.

jobs.description:
The Power of Now

Be part of something big. Fortescue is leading the world with our plan to decarbonise our iron ore operations, projects that harness renewable energy and the development of technology that will change our planet forever.

An opportunity has arisen for a Senior Engineer to join the Motorsport & Advanced Engineering department.

About the role

The motorsport and advanced engineering team have project workload that requires an experienced design engineer with a strong skillset of mechanical design, ideally in the context of electrification. The projects are high performance in nature, with a focus on lightweight and powerful systems across motorsport, defence and other applications.

What you will do

As a member of the design and analysis engineering team your duties will include:

Responsible for design across mechanical, electrical and thermal projects

Lead engineering design principles across multiple disciplines

Line management of engineers, with responsibility for output and professional development

Represent Fortescue Zero in front of customers and suppliers

Effective communication with other engineering teams

Continuously improve engineering and business systems and processes

Create Design Verification Plans

Interpret regulations and standards, then develop plans to demonstrate conformity

Project planning of resource and tasks to meet requirements

Problem solving and fault rectification

In addition, your duties may also include:

Conducting design reviews and drawing checking

Design for performance, efficiency and total cost optimisation

Occasional event or test support

Responsibility for the health and safety of those working on a project

Develop supply chain

About you

Must have high quality mechanical design experience (>5 years) in high performance applications such as motorsport, defence, aerospace.

Significant exposure to HV systems, energy storage and low volume applications is highly desirable

Composites and structural design with FEA experience is advantageous.

Must be a proficient CAD (Siemens NX preferred) and PLM (Siemens Teamcenter preferred) user.

Demonstrated leadership potential alongside effective communication skills

Must be able to achieve and maintain Base Line Security Clearance (BPSS) for this role.

Ability to travel outside the UK

Our UK benefits include:

Bonus scheme

Group Income Protection

Electric Car Scheme

Health Cash Plan

Employee Assistance Programme

Private Medical Insurance

26 days holiday
plus

jobs.title: Industrial Placement (2027-2028) - Control Systems - Jaguar TCS Racing
jobs.description:
Accelerate Your Career

Jaguar TCS Racing is at the forefront of electric motorsport innovation, competing in the electrifying Formula E Championship. As part of the legendary Jaguar brand, our team is dedicated to pioneering advancements in electric vehicle technology, sustainability, and performance. With a rich heritage in racing and a commitment to pushing the boundaries of electric mobility, Jaguar TCS Racing combines passion, expertise, and cutting-edge technology to compete at the highest levels of motorsport.

We operate a 12-month (September 2027 - August 2028) student placement programme within our Formula E Control Systems group. This is an exciting opportunity where you will work with highly skilled and experienced engineering professionals and graduates who you can learn and develop with - the more questions you ask the more you will gain from your experience.   It is important to know that many of our industrial placements have been successful in obtaining graduate roles on completion of their degree.

To be eligible for an industrial placement within our Formula E Control Systems group you should be working towards a degree in Mechanical, Aerospace, Automotive, Electronics, Mechatronics, Software or Motorsport Engineering.  An understanding of vehicle dynamics would be advantageous.

What you will do

During the placement you will take on responsibilities such as:

Working as an integral part of Car Development Team

Developing control strategies using the MATLAB toolchain for both our on-car and off-car environments, DIL, HIL, to optimise the vehicle control software and realise quantifiable reductions in lap time over a race weekend.

Developing of new methodologies and test procedures to ensure we achieve and maintain a high level of code test coverage within our Vehicle Control Module, Inverter and Motor Control software.

Testing of our hardware and control modules across a variety of test facilities.

Preparation and support of systems on operational vehicles at test and race events

Overall, you will contribute to make our car faster, more reliable and more efficient.

When applying for industrial placements opportunities, all students are expected to submit a covering letter along with a Curriculum Vitae containing the following information: 

• Your current career aims and how you plan to achieve them. 

• Subjects that you are currently taking and plan to take. 

• Relevant leisure pursuits and activities. 

• Why work experience would be beneficial to you.

Next Steps

Those students that are shortlisted will be invited to attend an assessment.  It is expected that the student takes sole responsibility for making suitable travel and accommodation arrangements.

Our Commitment

You do not need to match every listed expectation to apply for this position. At Fortescue Zero we are committed to building a team that encompasses a variety of backgrounds, experiences and skills.  

Fortescue Zero is an equal opportunity employer who values diversity and inclusion. If you have a disability, 

We are happy to discuss reasonable job adjustments.

jobs.title: Supervisor, Mining
jobs.description:
Job Description

Job Title Supervisor, Mining
Reporting to Superintendent, Mining
Business Unit / Function GGM
Department Mining Production - GGM
Grade M10

Why This Role Matters
The role is Supervisor Mining is responsible for overseeing and coordinating mining activities at a designated mine site. This role involves managing a team of mining operators, ensuring adherence to safety and environmental regulations, optimizing production efficiency, and coordinating with other departments to achieve production targets. The Supervisor Mining plays a critical role in ensuring the safe and efficient extraction of ore, managing equipment utilization, and implementing best practices to maximize productivity.

What You Will Deliver
Supervise and coordinate mining operations, including drilling, blasting, loading, hauling, and dumping activities, to achieve daily, weekly, and monthly production targets.

Ensure compliance with safety regulations, standard operating procedures (SOPs), and environmental standards in all mining activities, conducting safety inspections, risk assessments, and incident investigations as required.

Provide leadership and direction to mining crews, assigning tasks, monitoring performance, and providing coaching and training to improve skills and efficiency.

Coordinate with mine planning and engineering teams to implement mine plans, optimize pit designs, and sequence mining activities to maximize ore recovery and minimize dilution.

Monitor equipment performance and utilization, coordinating maintenance activities and repairs to minimize downtime and maximize equipment availability.

Conduct regular inspections of mining equipment, infrastructure, and work areas, identifying maintenance requirements, safety hazards, and opportunities for process improvements.

Maintain accurate production records, shift reports, and equipment logs, preparing reports and documentation for management review and regulatory compliance.

Liaise with other departments, such as geology, processing, and maintenance, to coordinate ore delivery, grade control, and equipment scheduling to support overall production objectives.

Monitor and control operating costs, managing consumables, fuel consumption, and labor resources to optimize productivity and minimize operating expenses.

Foster a culture of teamwork, accountability, and continuous improvement among mining personnel, promoting adherence to company policies, values, and performance standards.

Minimum Qualifications
• Bachelor's degree in mining engineering, geology, or related field; additional certifications in mine supervision or leadership are advantageous.

Experience
Minimum of 5-7 years of experience in open-pit or underground mining operations, with at least 2-3 years in a supervisory or leadership role.

Skills That Matter
Strong understanding of mine planning principles, ore reserve estimation, and grade control practices to optimize production and minimize ore loss and dilution.

Proficiency in mine safety regulations, risk management practices, and environmental compliance requirements applicable to mining operations.

Excellent leadership and communication skills, with the ability to motivate and inspire teams, resolve conflicts, and foster a positive work culture.

Sound analytical and problem-solving abilities, with the capacity to identify operational inefficiencies, implement corrective actions, and drive continuous improvement initiatives.

jobs.title: Senior Corporate Accountant
jobs.description:
Nussir søker erfaren regnskapsfører

Ønsker du å bidra til verdiskapning og bolyst i Finnmark? Ønsker du å være med fra starten i et betydelig og svært spennende selskap med internasjonal hverdag? Ønsker du å bo i nord og gi andre muligheten til det samme?

Gruveprosjektet Nussir har stor fremdrift og søker en erfaren autorisert regnskapsfører.

Nussir er en del av det børsnoterte konsernet Blue Moon Metals Inc. som er listet på TSX og NASDAQ. Den norske delen av konsernet har i dag seksti ansatte og forventer sterk vekst frem til stabil produksjon i 2028.

Stillingen har følgende ansvarsområder:

Lede den regnskapsmessige overgangen fra konstruksjonsfasen til produksjon

Ansvar for selskapets regnskapsføring og regnskapsprosesser

Utarbeidelse av måneds-, kvartals- og årsregnskap

Sikre etterlevelse av gjeldende lover, regler og regnskapsstandarder

Ansvar for skatte- og avgiftsrapportering

Koordinering og oppfølging av revisjon

Videreutvikling av interne rutiner, prosesser og kontroller via SAP

Bidra til budsjett-, prognose- og rapporteringsprosesser

Delta i finansielle analyser og beslutningsunderlag for ledelsen

Samarbeid med eksterne rådgivere, myndigheter og øvrige forretningsområder

Ønskede kvalifikasjoner:

Autorisert regnskapsfører

Høyere økonomisk utdannelse innen regnskap, revisjon eller økonomi

Minimum 5 års relevant erfaring innen regnskap, revisjon eller økonomistyring

Solid kompetanse innen norsk regnskapsregelverk

Internasjonal og IFRS erfaring er en fordel

Erfaring med årsoppgjør, skatt og avgift

God systemforståelse og erfaring med ERP-systemer, erfaring med SAP er en fordel

Meget gode ferdigheter i Excel

God skriftlig og muntlig fremstillingsevne på norsk og engelsk

Stillingen byr på betydelige muligheter for læring og vekst, og en del av et konsern i sterk vekst. Stillingen vil ha påvirkningsmulighet i forhold etableringen av et gruveprosjekt i Kvalsund og målsetning om å benytte tid i gruven og prosessanlegget. Det forventes kandidater benytter minst fem arbeidsdager i måneden i Repparfjord. Kontorsted: Hammefest eller Alta.

Stillingen har innebærer personalansvar. Det benyttes for tiden regnskapstjenester fra Admento på regnskap, lønn og IFRS.

Stillingen rapporterer til Head of Finance Norway. For mer informasjon om stillingen, kontakt Alexander Krogh på mobil 416 48 650.

Søknadsfrist: kandidater vurderes løpende

Nussir seeks an experienced Chief Accountant

Would you like to contribute to value creation and help strengthen local communities in Finnmark? Would you like to join a significant and highly exciting company from the ground up, operating in an international environment? Do you want to live in Northern Norway and help create opportunities for others to do the same?
The Nussir mining project is making strong progress and is seeking an experienced Certified Accountant to join our team.

Nussir is part of the publicly listed Blue Moon Metals Inc. group, which is listed on both the TSX and NASDAQ stock exchanges. The Norwegian operations currently employ approximately sixty people and are expected to experience significant growth leading up to stable production in 2028.

Key Responsibilities:

Manage the accounting transition from construction to production

Responsibility for the company's accounting operations and financial processes

Preparation of monthly, quarterly, and annual financial statements

Ensure compliance with applicable laws, regulations, and accounting standards

Responsibility for tax and VAT reporting

Coordinate and manage external audits

Further develop internal routines, processes, and controls

Contribute to budgeting, forecasting, and reporting processes

Participate in financial analysis and the preparation of decision support for management

Collaborate with external advisors, authorities, and other business functions

Desired Qualifications:

Certified Accountant (Authorized Accountant)

Higher education in Accounting, Auditing, Finance, or Economics

Minimum 5 years of relevant experience in accounting, auditing, or financial management

Strong knowledge of Norwegian accounting regulations; experience with IFRS is an advantage

Experience with year-end closing, taxation, and VAT reporting

Strong systems understanding and experience with ERP systems

International and SAP experience is an advantage

Advanced Excel skills

Excellent written and verbal communication skills in both Norwegian and English

The position offers significant opportunities for learning and professional growth as part of a rapidly expanding group. The successful candidate will have the opportunity to influence the development of the mining project in Kvalsund and will be expected to spend time both at the mine site and at the processing plant. Candidates are expected to spend a minimum of five working days per month in Repparfjord. The office location is either Hammerfest or Alta.

The position includes personnel management responsibilities. Accounting, payroll, and IFRS services are currently provided by Admento.
The position reports to the Head of Finance Norway. For further information regarding the position, please contact Alexander Krogh at +47 416 48 650.

Application Deadline:
Applications will be reviewed on an ongoing basis.

jobs.title: Porgera | Officer - Asset Protection Department (APD)
jobs.description:
About Us

New Porgera Limited (NPL) is a leading mining company dedicated to sustainable practices and community engagement in Papua New Guinea. As the operator of the Porgera Gold Mine, we focus on extracting high-quality mineral resources while prioritizing the well-being of our employees, the environment, and the local communities. Our commitment to safety, innovation, and responsible mining ensures that we not only contribute to the economy but also support the development and prosperity of the regions we operate in. At NPL, we strive to create a positive impact, fostering strong relationships with stakeholders and promoting sustainable growth for future generations.

The New Porgera Limited now has a vacancy for a qualified and experienced individual as
Asset Protection Officer - APD
(******)

About the role

Reporting to the
Chief Duty Officer (CDO)
, the Asset Protection officer will be supervising local security employees in their day-to-day function as well as providing security to the New Porgera mine site and its associated installations. The role is to maintain Security across the Mining Operations by monitoring and reporting of civil disturbances and breaches of safety and other company policies. A high level of competency is required. This role is an operational field role requiring team work.

In this role, you will:

• Maintain Security across the Mining Operations

jobs.title: Especialista de Servicios a las Personas - Mantenimiento
jobs.description:
Anglo American, en sociedad con la Corporación Mitsubishi, está desarrollando la operación minera Quellaveco, uno de los yacimientos de cobre más grandes del mundo, localizado en la región de Moquegua, al sur del Perú.

Quellaveco tendrá una vida de reservas de 30 años. Utilizará proceso minero de tajo abierto y flotación para producir concentrados de cobre, así como molibdeno y plata como subproductos. Se espera que Quellaveco produzca en promedio 300 mil toneladas de cobre por año en sus primeros 10 años de operación.

En Anglo American nuestra estrategia es asegurar y desarrollar Quellaveco aplicando prácticas y tecnologías innovadoras que confiamos a nuestra gente. Estamos comprometidos a convertirnos en socios para el futuro, operar con seguridad, sustentabilidad y responsabilidad.

Especialista de Servicios a las Personas - Mantenimiento.

Mediante la planificación, ejecución y control de recursos de los servicios de mantenimiento del área, con un enfoque integral (preventivo, correctivo y de mejora continua), orientado a la atención eficiente, la continuidad del servicio y la mejora de la calidad de vida de los colaboradores.

Participar activamente en proyectos de modernización y optimización de la infraestructura, aportando soluciones que fortalezcan la experiencia de los usuarios y la sostenibilidad de la operación.

FUNCIONES PRINCIPALES:

Desarrollar y ejecutar planes de mantenimiento preventivo y correctivo para garantizar la operatividad y seguridad de las instalaciones y equipos de la compañía.

Cumplir el presupuesto asignado al servicio de mantenimiento (alrededor de $5.3M al año), contribuyendo a los objetivos financieros del área mediante el uso eficiente de recursos.

Asegurar el cumplimiento de indicadores de rendimiento (KPIs) que evalúen la eficacia, la eficiencia del servicio de mantenimiento de infraestructura y equipos (módulos de alojamiento, edificios, comedores, estacionamientos, entre otros) con orientación a la mejora de calidad de vida de los colaboradores y experiencia el usuario.

Supervisar y coordinar las actividades de las empresas contratistas, identificando, reportando y corrigiendo desviaciones para asegurar el cumplimiento de políticas, procedimientos y estándares de calidad y seguridad

Establecer y controlar los planes de mantenimiento, asignando recursos adecuados y garantizando el cumplimiento de los plazos establecidos.

Elaborar reportes mensuales sobre el desempeño y resultados del servicio de mantenimiento, cumpliendo plazos de entrega y proponiendo acciones de mejora continua e innovación.

Controlar y verificar los inventarios de materiales y repuestos, optimizando recursos y asegurando la sostenibilidad del servicio

Gestionar la información requerida para auditorías internas y externas, y realizar evaluaciones periódicas del estado de instalaciones y equipos, proponiendo mejoras continuas.

Proponer, desarrollar y ejecutar proyectos de mejora e innovación en infraestructura, orientados a fortalecer la experiencia de los usuarios y la calidad de vida de los colaboradores.

FUNCIONES Y RESPONSABILIDADES SHE:

Conocer y aplicar los valores, principios y la Política SHE de Anglo American Quellaveco y contribuir a su visión de cero daños.

Asegurar que las medidas de control para los peligros y riesgos de SHE, relacionadas con las actividades a desempeñar, se encuentren implementadas en el lugar de trabajo, para el desarrollo de una labor segura.

Cumplir los estándares, procedimientos y reglamentos internos del Sistema de Gestión; así como participar activamente en las reuniones de capacitación, concientización y formación de la cultura de Cero Daños.

Reportar oportunamente los actos y condiciones inseguras; así como los incidentes.

FORMACIÓN Y CERTIFICACIONES

Formación universitaria en ingeniería industrial, ingeniería mecánica, ingeniería eléctrica, ingeniería civil, administración de empresas, carreras afines.

Profesional colegiado y habilitado, indispensable.

Licencia de Conducir (A1), indispensable.

Manejo de SAP, deseable

EXPERIENCIA

Tener como mínimo 5 años de experiencia en posiciones similares. De preferencia en empresas del sector minero o industrias afines (Servicios minería, energia, gas, construcción, etc.)

Experiencia en manejo de servicios de mantenimiento de infraestructura y equipos.

Experiencia en planificación y supervisión de empresas contratistas de servicios de mantenimiento.

Sobre el rol

Sistema: 8X6

Contrato: Permanente

Siguiente etapa

De continuar a la siguiente etapa, recibirá un correo por parte de nosotros invitándolo a completar su primera evaluación en nuestra plataforma HireVue y un formulario de datos en Ms Forms. Agradeceremos estar muy atento a su bandeja de entrada o de correo no deseados, a fin de continuar con cada una de las etapas de nuestro proceso dentro de los tiempos establecidos.
