jobs.title: Civil/Earthworks Engineer, Trainee
jobs.description:
Ausenco es una empresa de rápido crecimiento y grandes ideas. Redefinimos lo que es posible en algunos de los proyectos más complejos y entornos más difíciles del mundo. Entregamos soluciones innovadoras a través de estudios de consultoría de alto valor agregado; ejecución de proyectos; operación de activos y optimización de mantenimiento. Desde 21 oficinas en 9 países, con proyectos en más de 80 ubicaciones en todo el mundo, creamos resultados sostenibles para nuestra gente, clientes y comunidades.

Nuestro equipo en Perú está creciendo, actualmente nos encontramos reclutando un Civil Earthworks Engineer, Trainee, para unirse a nuestra línea de negocios de Mineral & Metal en la oficina de San Isidro.

Acerca del rol

Como Civil Earthworks Engineer – Trainee formarás parte del equipo que desarrolla soluciones para obras de movimiento de tierras, hidráulica e infraestructura civil–minera. Colaborarás en el diseño y modelamiento de caminos, plataformas, obras hidráulicas y sistemas de manejo de aguas pluviales, utilizando herramientas de modelado 3D, softwares hidráulicos y criterios aplicados a proyectos mineros.

Participarás activamente en la revisión de entregables de ingeniería, estimaciones de cantidades, elaboración de planos y reportes técnicos; así como en la interacción con equipos multidisciplinarios como geotecnia, hidrología e hidrogeología.

Responsabilidades Clave:

Participar en el diseño de instalaciones de infraestructura minera
Diseño de infraestructura para el manejo de aguas de escorrentía superficial
Elaboración de bloques de diseño de obras civiles y obras hidráulicas
Realizar el estimado de cantidades de los materiales que se utilizará en el proyecto.
Realizar sustentos de metrados
Elaboración y revisión de planos y figuras civiles-hidráulicos.
Ejecutar las investigaciones en temas del área.

Acerca de ti :

Profesional Egresado de la carrera de Ingeniería Civil inclinado hacia la especialidad de Caminos y/o Hidráulica.
Conocimiento de AutoCad Civil 3D, nivel intermedio, aplicado al diseño de infraestructura civil tipo caminos, plataformas, canales o levantamientos topográficos.
Conocimiento básico de software de modelación hidráulica HEC-RAS o IBER
Buenas habilidades en comunicación oral y escrita.

¿Por qué Ausenco?

Apoyamos el crecimiento individual y nuestro objetivo es permitirte trabajar de una manera que aproveche tus fortalezas y cubra tus necesidades. Conoce la Propuesta de Valor Ausenco:

Compensación y Beneficios: Más allá de un paquete de remuneración competitivo, podrás acceder a nuestro modelo de trabajo híbrido, que te permite equilibrar los días de oficina con el trabajo desde casa. Disfruta de los beneficios de nuestras políticas de licencia incluida la licencia parental remunerada, y participa de eventos corporativos y celebraciones de fechas importantes en un ambiente de trabajo positivo y entretenido.

Crecimiento y Desarrollo: Recibe apoyo continuo en tu desarrollo personal y profesional con capacitación técnica, programas de tutoría y oportunidades frecuentes para generar redes de trabajo a nivel global.

Balance y Bienestar: Adopta un enfoque proactivo para tu bienestar general. Accede a consejería confidencial, servicios de salud y un programa de beneficios que respalden tus necesidades.

Reconocimiento y Apreciación: Participa de espacios multidireccionales donde se fomenta una cultura de reconocimiento local y global, en donde todos son reconocidos por su contribución al negocio y los proyectos.

Comunicación y Compromiso: Vive la experiencia de trabajar en una compañía dinámica con procesos globales y trabaja de la mano con líderes de la industria de gran reputación que valoren tu contribución.

Nuestra gente no se conforma con el statu quo. Si tienes espíritu emprendedor y quieres ayudar a establecer un nuevo estándar en sostenibilidad, te ayudaremos a encontrar tu lugar. Esto significa trabajar contigo para desarrollar una trayectoria profesional y un conjunto de habilidades que coincidan con tu ambición.

Estamos orgullosos del trabajo que hacemos y lo hacemos dentro de una cultura abierta, honesta y cooperativa. Tenemos un historial de atraer a personas visionarias que aceptan desafíos y brindan soluciones creativas para cada proyecto, y tu voz es una parte importante de esa conversación.

Como compañía global creemos en la diversidad y la impulsamos en su sentido más amplio – identidad de género, expresión de género, orientación sexual, edad, experiencia, nacionalidad, etnia, idioma, religión, educación, discapacidad, habilidades, estilos de trabajo y dónde te encuentras ubicado. Nuestro ambiente de trabajo se basa en la confianza y el respeto por los derechos y las oportunidades de todos los individuos.

Únete a Ausenco y trabaja de una mejor manera.

jobs.title: Mine Maintenance Superintendent
jobs.description:
Mine Maintenance Superintendent

Position Specifications

Position: 
Mine Maintenance Superintendent

Location:
 Oko West Project, Guyana
 
The Mine Maintenance Superintendent will lead all maintenance activities for the mining fleet at the Oko West Project in Guyana, ensuring safe execution while maximising equipment availability, reliability and cost effectiveness in support of production targets.
Reporting to the Mine Manager, the role leads the maintenance team — general foremen, engineers, supervisors, planners and technicians — and coordinates closely with Mine Operations, Supply Chain, Warehouse, Engineering, OEMs and contractors to ensure effective maintenance planning, execution, parts availability and continuous improvement. This is a rotation-based role in a remote mining environment, requiring strong field presence and effective coordination of maintenance activities across operating shifts.

The Company

In 2020, G Mining Ventures (GMIN) was created to acquire direct ownership of projects and capitalise on the value uplift that successful mine development offers. In July 2024, GMIN acquired the Oko West Project, a new gold discovery in northwest Guyana located approximately 95 km west of Georgetown, which the Company is now developing into an operating mine. Our client has selected Globe 24-7 Inc. as its strategic recruitment partner to successfully fill the above-mentioned position and to add value to the hiring strategy with market knowledge, trends and a proven track record in conducting similar searches.

Main Responsibilities

Lead all planned, preventive, predictive and corrective maintenance activities for the mining fleet, including shovels, excavators, haul trucks, drills, dozers, graders, loaders and support equipment.

Maximise fleet availability and reliability by monitoring equipment condition, breakdowns, recurring failures, maintenance backlog, component life and maintenance KPIs, implementing timely corrective actions.

Ensure effective maintenance planning and scheduling, covering preventive maintenance, major repairs, component replacements, shutdowns, work orders, manpower, tooling and resources.

Lead maintenance general foremen, supervisors, planners, technicians and contractors, ensuring adequate staffing, competency development, performance management, accountability and effective shift handovers.

Ensure effective use of the Maintenance Management System, maintaining accurate equipment history, work orders, maintenance costs, parts consumption and performance data to support decision-making and continuous improvement.

Coordinate with Supply Chain, Warehouse, OEMs and suppliers to ensure availability of critical spare parts, consumables, major components, technical support and warranty follow-up.

Develop and control maintenance budgets, forecasts and costs, identifying opportunities to improve equipment lifecycle performance and reduce downtime and maintenance costs.

Provide visible safety leadership and ensure all maintenance activities comply with Company HSE standards, including isolation, lockout, lifting, stored energy, pressure systems and other maintenance-related critical risks.

Position Requirements

As the successful candidate, it is essential that you possess the following skills, experience and competencies:

Bachelor s degree in Mechanical Engineering, Industrial Maintenance or a related technical field preferred; equivalent technical qualifications combined with significant relevant experience may be considered.

Minimum 10 to 15 years of progressive heavy equipment maintenance experience, including at least five years in a senior supervisory or superintendent role.

Strong experience managing and maintaining large mining fleets and leading multidisciplinary maintenance teams.

Strong knowledge of preventive and predictive maintenance, equipment reliability, troubleshooting, root cause analysis, major component management and maintenance planning.

Strong understanding of maintenance KPIs, including equipment availability, MTBF, MTTR, schedule compliance, backlog and maintenance costs.

Proven experience with a Maintenance Management System and maintenance data management; SAP PM or a similar system is an asset.

Strong knowledge of maintenance budgeting, cost control, spare parts management and coordination with OEMs and suppliers.

Strong leadership, communication, organisational, analytical and decision-making skills, with the ability to operate effectively in a remote and demanding mining environment. 

In addition, the following behavioural competencies are essential to succeed in the role:

Strong safety leadership and field presence.

High level of accountability, ownership and operational discipline.

Strong problem-solving and decision-making capabilities.

Effective team leadership, coaching and development.

Strong collaboration with Operations and support departments.

Continuous improvement and equipment reliability mindset.

Compensation

Our client will provide a market-related remuneration package, including an annual performance bonus and participation in the Company s group medical and life insurance plan for the employee and dependents.
The position is residential at site on a rotational roster of 23 days on and 19 days off. For international candidates, the Company provides international and in-country travel, accommodation and meals while in Guyana, together with support throughout the required immigration process.

Contact Us 

To apply for this position, please send a copy of your resume in Word format.

Minimum 10 years underground heavy mining equipment maintenance and repair experience.

Ability to operate tools and equipment safely and apply approved work methods.

The Rewards

Based on a leading gold mining company, this position offers a competitive contract with a competitive remuneration package.

Uphold HSE standards, manage risks, and support operational and project targets.

Advise and coordinate UG HV maintenance, reticulation expansion, and daily infrastructure support.

Ensure compliance with legislation, standards, and management systems; participate in audits and maintain documentation.

Support Life-of-Mine planning, scopes of work, HV new builds, and capital project execution.

Monitor equipment performance, quality, and reporting, including inspections, work orders, and failure analyses.

Develop skills matrices and training programs; provide on-the-job coaching and maintain training records.

Liaise with site leadership, technical teams, and contractors to support progress, change, cost, and schedule.

jobs.title: Reclutador Masivo de Selección temporal (Sector Logístico) - Lurigancho
jobs.description:
Reclutador  Masivo de Selección temporal (Sector Logístico)
Ubicación: Huachipa (2 vacantes) / Villa El Salvador (2 vacantes)
Ingreso: Inmediato
En una empresa del sector logístico, nos encontramos en la búsqueda de Reclutador masivo  de Selección con experiencia en reclutamiento masivo de perfiles operativos, que deseen integrarse a un equipo dinámico y de alta demanda.
· ¿Cuál será tu propósito?
Asegurar la cobertura oportuna de posiciones operativas mediante procesos de reclutamiento ágiles, eficientes y orientados a resultados.
· Principales funciones:
Convocatorias en zonas estratégicas
Identificar y mapear zonas geográficas con mayor densidad de población objetivo (por perfil de puesto, rango etario, oficio).
Ejecutar convocatorias masivas en campo (plazas, mercados, terminales, zonas industriales, comunidades aledañas a operaciones).
Coordinar con autoridades locales, municipalidades o dirigentes comunales el permiso y logística para convocatorias en campo (relevante en contextos de responsabilidad social, como cuotas de contratación local en minería).
Volanteo y difusión física
Diseñar contenido y distribuir volantes, afiches o material publicitario del proceso de convocatoria.
Colocar banners o señalización en puntos estratégicos de alto tránsito peatonal.
Realizar perifoneo o difusión mediante radios locales cuando la zona lo amerite.
Visitas institucionales
Visitar institutos, universidades y centros de formación técnica para promover vacantes y establecer alianzas de práctica pre-profesional.
Visitar bolsas de empleo municipales o agencias de empleo público para ampliar la difusión.
Reclutamiento in situ en campamentos u operaciones (contexto minero/industrial)
Trasladarse a zonas empresariales para realizar procesos de selección directamente en campo.
Registro y trazabilidad del trabajo de campo
Levantar y consolidar la base de datos de candidatos captados en campo (formularios físicos o digitales con tablets/apps).
Elaborar reportes de cobertura y efectividad de cada actividad de campo (N.º de contactos, tasa de conversión a entrevista).
Presencia en ferias y eventos
Representar a la empresa/cliente en ferias laborales, ferias universitarias y eventos de empleabilidad.
Instalar y gestionar stands de reclutamiento, incluyendo material informativo y formularios de registro de candidatos.
Realizar entrevistas rápidas (speed interviews) o preselección in situ durante los eventos.
· ¿Qué buscamos?
Experiencia mínima de 1 año en reclutamiento masivo de perfiles operativos.
Experiencia en trabajo de campo y reclutamiento por redes sociales.
Alta agilidad, sentido de urgencia y tolerancia al trabajo bajo presión.
Capacidad de organización y enfoque en resultados.
· Condiciones:
Modalidad: Presencial
Horario: Lunes a viernes de 9:00 a.m. a 6:30 p.m.
Contrato: 2 meses por campaña.
Remuneración: S/ 1,800 S/ 2,000
Beneficio: Subvención alimentaria del 70%
Lugar: Lurigancho
· Importante:
Buscamos incorporar al equipo antes de finalizar el mes, por lo que el proceso será ágil.
· Si cuentas con experiencia en reclutamiento masivo y te interesa asumir este reto, ¡postula ahora!.

Recibir las Órdenes de Trabajo, completar el check list de equipos, aplicar el IPERC y cumplir con todas las herramientas de gestión de seguridad de la empresa. Realizar el muestreo en campo, ya sea de suelos, stream sediments, chips, canales y trincheras, y uso adecuado de herramientas como punta y comba. Ejecutar el corte y muestreo de testigos (cores) de perforación diamantina según los procedimientos establecidos. Realizar el muestreo de vetas, afloramientos rocosos y alteraciones con cortadora portátil, en superficie o interior mina, según requerimiento. Realizar levantamientos topográficos en superficie, sondajes, canales y otros puntos geológicos utilizando GPS diferencial. Apoyar en la recolección de muestras de mano para análisis mineralógico con equipo Terraspec Halo. Tomar fotografías de testigos de perforación y archivar correctamente para asegurar trazabilidad. Apoyar en el levantamiento y/o en las actividades de campo relacionadas a trabajos geofísicos, siguiendo indicaciones del supervisor. Apoyar en el embalaje y envío de cores de perforación diamantina a laboratorios externos, asegurando integridad y trazabilidad. Instalar las tuberías de agua y lodos, rotoplast, bandejas de contención, entre otros materiales relacionados a la campaña de perforación. Inspeccionar que los tanques de agua de RH estén llenos y verificar que los tanques de lodo estén vacíos durante una campaña de perforación diamantina. Realizar la limpieza de tanques Rotoplast con lodos de perforación y mantener el orden y limpieza de equipos y área de trabajo. Instalar y desinstalar pararrayos en zonas de exploración para garantizar la seguridad de las operaciones. Conocimiento general del cálculo de RQD y uso de herramientas geotécnicas. Conocimientos de manejo básico del equipo Terraspec Halo.Beneficios: Ingreso a planilla con todos los beneficios de ley. Participación en utilidades. Costos de alimentación y hospedaje cubiertos por la compañia. Movilidad coberturada por la compañia desde: Arequipa, Juliaca y Espinar (Cusco)¡No pierdas la oportunidad de ser parte de un equipo que está marcando la diferencia en la industria! Postula ahora y construyamos juntos al crecimiento de la minería en nuestro país.

Misión del puesto

Diseñar, implementar y optimizar mecanismos de integración entre los sistemas, plataformas y fuentes de información utilizados por el Programa Life Extension 2, mediante la definición de estándares, flujos de datos y soluciones tecnológicas, con el propósito de asegurar la disponibilidad, consistencia y trazabilidad de la información requerida para la gestión y toma de decisiones del programa, acorde a las políticas de la empresa y de los requerimientos de sus sistemas de gestión.

Responsabilidades y actividades principales

Analizar los requerimientos funcionales y no funcionales de integración del Programa LE2, identificando dependencias, restricciones, riesgos y alternativas de solución, a fin de definir diseños técnicamente viables, escalables y sostenibles.

Diseñar soluciones de integración entre los sistemas y plataformas utilizados por el Programa LE2, con el propósito de facilitar el intercambio oportuno y confiable de información entre las diferentes áreas y procesos.

Implementar mecanismos de interoperabilidad entre aplicaciones, bases de datos y herramientas digitales, a fin de asegurar la disponibilidad y consistencia de la información del programa.

Definir estándares, protocolos y lineamientos de integración de datos, con el propósito de promover la calidad, trazabilidad y gobernanza de la información.              

Administrar los flujos de intercambio de información entre plataformas corporativas y sistemas del programa, a fin de minimizar reprocesos y reducir la duplicidad de datos.

Monitorear el desempeño de las integraciones implementadas, identificando oportunidades de mejora y acciones correctivas que contribuyan a la continuidad operativa de los sistemas.

Participar en la implementación de nuevas plataformas digitales, evaluando requerimientos de integración, compatibilidad y confidencialidad de los datos, con el propósito de asegurar su incorporación eficiente al ecosistema tecnológico del programa.

Desarrollar documentación técnica, diagramas de arquitectura y procedimientos asociados a las integraciones de sistemas, a fin de facilitar su mantenimiento y sostenibilidad.

Analizar incidencias relacionadas con la transferencia e integración de datos, proponiendo soluciones que contribuyan a mantener la confiabilidad de la información.

Cumplir las normas y procedimientos de Seguridad Industrial a fin de proteger la vida y salud de las personas, prevenir accidentes graves y garantizar operaciones seguras y sostenibles.

Cumplir con otras responsabilidades delegadas por su supervisión directa ligadas a su posición que aseguren la sostenibilidad del negocio.

Experiencia trabajando con plataformas corporativas de gestión de proyectos, ingeniería o gestión documental.

jobs.title: Strategic Partnership Manager - Motorsport & Advanced Engineering
jobs.description:
The Power of Now

Be part of something big. Fortescue is leading the world with our plan to decarbonise our iron ore operations, projects that harness renewable energy and the development of technology that will change our planet forever.

An opportunity has arisen for a Strategic Partnership Manager to join the Motorsport & Advanced Engineering department.

About the role

This role supports the successful conversion of strategic opportunities into contracted business across the motorsport, advanced engineering, and defence sectors, with a focus on elite performance electrification technology, energy storage systems, and zero-emission power system components.

Working closely with senior commercial leaders who own key customer relationships and opportunity origination, this role is responsible for identifying leads and driving opportunity execution, including bid development, commercial structuring, pricing, internal stakeholder coordination, and contract negotiation. In addition, the role will also be required to own and maintain ongoing customer relationships and generate additional revenue opportunities from existing accounts in addition to new business.

What will you do

Opportunity Execution & Bid Management

Lead the end-to-end development of customer proposals, from initial brief through to submission

Coordinate inputs from engineering, product, finance, legal, and commercial teams

Ensure proposals are technically credible, commercially competitive, and aligned with customer requirements

Manage bid timelines, governance, and internal approval processes

Commercial Structuring & Pricing

Develop pricing models, cost build-ups, and commercial structures in collaboration with finance and technical teams

Support definition of commercial strategies, including risk allocation and contract positioning

Ensure alignment with internal financial targets and risk frameworks

Contract Development & Negotiation

Lead the preparation of commercial terms and contract documentation

Support and participate in contract negotiations with customers

Work closely with legal and commercial ops teams to ensure robust and compliant agreements

Internal Coordination

Act as the central point of coordination across multiple internal stakeholders

Ensure clear communication between opportunity owners (senior leads) and delivery teams

Track and manage actions, dependencies, and risks across opportunities

Customer Engagement 

Support senior commercial leads in customer interactions, particularly during bid and negotiation phases

Pursue new opportunities through active participation in the market (e.g. industry shows, events, outreach)

Contribute to development of customer-specific value propositions and materials

Pipeline & Reporting

Maintain accurate records of opportunity progress, pipeline status, and forecasts within CRM system

Provide structured updates on bid performance, risks, and key milestones

Market & Continuous Improvement

Support market and competitor analysis to strengthen proposal quality

Contribute to improving bid processes, tools, and commercial frameworks

Assist in improving existing standardised templates, pricing models, and collateral

About you

Adequate experience in commercial, bid management, or business development role within tier 1 motorsport, advanced engineering, defence, or high-technology sectors

Demonstrated experience in managing complex bids or opportunity lifecycles

Proven track record of developing commercial proposals and closing contracts

Experience in pricing, cost modelling, or commercial structuring

Experience working in cross-functional technical environments

Exposure to regulated or defence procurement environments (advantageous)

Familiarity with CRM systems such as Salesforce is desirable

Strong commercial and financial acumen

Excellent account management and organisational skills

Ability to coordinate multi-disciplinary teams under tight timelines

Strong written communication skills, particularly in proposal and contract development

High attention to detail with ability to manage multiple concurrent opportunities

What is in it for you?

Our UK benefits include:

Bonus scheme

Aviva Pension

Group Life Assurance

Group Income Protection

Electric Car Scheme

Health Cash Plan

Employee Assistance Programme

Private Medical Insurance

26 days holiday
plus
public holidays and the opportunity to purchase an additional 5 days per year

Childcare Benefits

Free on-site gym access and discounted national memberships

jobs.title: Supervisor de HSE/Arequipa/Campamento Minero - Regimen 14X7 / Unidad Minera
jobs.description:
¡SODEXO busca ser parte de la familia del mejor talento en el cargo de Supervisor de HSE!
Si, tu ADN está compuesto por:
- 100% espíritu de servicio
- 100% espíritu de progreso
- 100% espíritu de equipo
¡Esta es tu oportunidad!
REQUISITOS
Colegiado(a) habilitado de diversas carreras de Ingeniería de Minas, Ingeniero Geólogo, Ingeniero Químico o Ingeniero Metalurgista, Ambiental, Industrial o afines.
120 horas de capacitación en temas afines.
Experiencia mínima de 03 años en SSOMA (verificable en CUL).
Experiencia en gestión de prevención y análisis de riesgo, salud y medio ambiente.
Experiencia en empresas del mismo rubro (Deseable).
Experiencia en minería o SSRR (Deseable).
Manejo Excel a nivel intermedio.
Deseable residencia en Arequipa, Cuzco, Puno, Moquegua, Tacna. En caso de ser de Lima se ofrecerá básico de 4K para subvencionarse el pasaje aéreo.
FUNCIONES
Brindar asesoría a la Jefatura de Operaciones en temas de Medio Ambiente, Seguridad y Salud Ocupacional, asegurando el cumplimiento de la normativa vigente.
Supervisar el cumplimiento de los programas de control y reducción de riesgos, así como las condiciones de seguridad en el trabajo.
Evaluar el cumplimiento de los objetivos y programas de gestión de Seguridad, Salud Ocupacional y Medio Ambiente, proponiendo mejoras cuando sea necesario.
Planificar y ejecutar auditorías internas relacionadas con Seguridad, Salud Ocupacional y Medio Ambiente.
Preparar información e informes de gestión para la Gerencia y autoridades regulatorias, según corresponda.
Administrar y mantener actualizada la documentación del Sistema de Gestión Integrado, de acuerdo con los estándares y requisitos aplicables.
Realizar seguimiento al cumplimiento de los programas de gestión ambiental, seguridad y salud ocupacional.
Proponer e implementar acciones de mejora orientadas a fortalecer la gestión de SST y Medio Ambiente.
Otras funciones relacionadas con el puesto que sean asignadas por la jefatura.
¿QUÉ TE OFRECEMOS?
Cobertura al 100% de Alimentación, estadía y transporte.
Capacitación constante.
Línea de carrera.
Excelente clima laboral.-Requerimientos- Educación mínima: Universitario
2 años de experiencia
Palabras clave: residente, encargado, supervisor, subgerente, responsable, coordinador, gestor, capitan, miner, mineria, minero

jobs.title: INSPECTOR DE SEGURIDAD EN MINA
jobs.company: CONTRATISTAS ESPECIALISTA EN TRABAJOS MINEROS Y CIVILES S.A.C. - CETRAMIN SAC
jobs.description:
Somos *CETRAMIN SAC*, empresa especializada con mas de 20 años de experiencia en la ejecución de labores mineras de desarrollo y explotación de yacimientos de metales preciosos, solicitamos *INSPECTOR DE SEGURIDAD *para laborar en *UNIDAD MINERA EN CONDESUYOS AREQUIPA*

*REQUISITOS*

* *Formación:* Bachiller o Titulado en *Ingeniería de Minas, Ingeniería de Seguridad*
* *Experiencia:* Mínima de *2 años* en el cargo y el área de Seguridad y Salud Ocupacional, directamente en *minería subterránea*
* *Especialización:* Conocimiento sólido en control de riesgos críticos subterráneos: sostenimiento de rocas (mallas, pernos, madera), ventilación, manipulación de explosivos y trabajos en altura.

*FUNCIONES*

* *Verificar en campo* el cumplimiento de los estándares de seguridad, procedimientos de trabajo y el uso correcto del EPP por parte del personal operativo.
* *Identificar y reportar* actos y condiciones subestándares en interior mina, paralizando labores si el nivel de riesgo compromete la integridad física del trabajador.
* *Supervisar la ejecución* de trabajos de alto riesgo

*BENEFICIOS*

* *Régimen:* Sistema de trabajo *20 x 10*
* *Cobertura total:* *Alimentación, movilidad interna/externa y estadía cubiertas al 100%* en el campamento minero.
* *Contratación:* Ingreso inmediato a planilla con todos los *beneficios de ley* desde el primer día de labores.

Comunicarse al correo o al whatsapp 942623203

Sueldo: S/.3,400.00 - S/.3,500.00 al mes

Lugar de trabajo: Empleo presencial

jobs.title: Encargado de Logística
jobs.company: Sociedad Minera Virgen de Copacabana S.A.C
jobs.description:
*CONTRATACIÓN DE ENCARGADO DE LOGÍSTICA*

*1. OBJETIVO DE LA CONTRATACIÓN*

Contratar un profesional responsable de planificar, coordinar y supervisar las actividades logísticas de la unidad minera, asegurando el abastecimiento oportuno de bienes, materiales, equipos y servicios requeridos para la continuidad de las operaciones.

*2. PUESTO*

Encargado de Logística

*3. LUGAR DE TRABAJO*

Sociedad Minera Virgen de Copacabana S.A.C ubicada en el Departamento de Arequipa - Secocha.

*4. RÉGIMEN LABORAL*

* Sistema de trabajo: 22 días laborados x 8 días de descanso.
* Pagos mensuales.
* Jornada de trabajo de acuerdo con el régimen minero y políticas de la empresa.

*5. REMUNERACIÓN*

* Sueldo mensual: entre S/ 3,000.00 y S/ 3,500.00, de acuerdo con la evaluación del perfil y experiencia del postulante.
* Emisión de Recibos por Honorarios
* Alimentación y hospedaje cubiertos durante la permanencia en la unidad minera

*6. PERFIL DEL PUESTO*

*Formación Académica*

* Técnico o Bachiller en Administración, Ingeniería Industrial, Ingeniería de Minas, Contabilidad o carreras afines.
* Deseable capacitación en logística, almacenes, abastecimiento o gestión de compras.

*Experiencia*

* Experiencia mínima de 2 a 3 años desempeñando funciones similares en empresas del sector minero.
* Experiencia en gestión de almacenes, abastecimiento, compras y control de inventarios.

*Conocimientos*

* Gestión logística y cadena de suministro.
* Control de inventarios y almacenes.
* Elaboración y seguimiento de órdenes de compra.
* Manejo de indicadores logísticos.
* Manejo de Microsoft Office (Excel intermedio o avanzado).
* Deseable manejo de sistemas ERP.

*7. FUNCIONES PRINCIPALES*

* Gestionar los requerimientos de materiales, herramientas, equipos e insumos de las diferentes áreas de la unidad minera.
* Coordinar procesos de compra y abastecimiento con proveedores.
* Realizar seguimiento a órdenes de compra y tiempos de entrega.
* Controlar el ingreso, almacenamiento y salida de materiales.
* Mantener actualizado el inventario físico y documentario del almacén.
* Elaborar reportes logísticos e indicadores de gestión.
* Coordinar el transporte y distribución de materiales dentro de la operación.
* Verificar el cumplimiento de los procedimientos internos de logística y almacén.
* Optimizar costos y tiempos en los procesos logísticos.
* Cumplir las normas de seguridad, salud ocupacional y medio ambiente establecidas por la empresa.

*8. COMPETENCIAS*

* Planificación y organización.
* Orientación a resultados.
* Trabajo en equipo.
* Comunicación efectiva.
* Capacidad de análisis y resolución de problemas.
* Responsabilidad y compromiso.
* Adaptabilidad al trabajo bajo régimen minero.

*9. DOCUMENTOS A PRESENTAR*

* Currículum Vitae documentado.
* Copia de DNI.
* Certificados de estudios.
* Certificados o constancias de trabajo que acrediten la experiencia requerida.
* Certificados de capacitaciones relacionadas al puesto (de contar con ellos).

*NOTA IMPORTANTE*

* Oportunidad de desarrollo profesional.
* Contar con certificados de trabajo que acrediten experiencia.
* De preferencia Residir en Zona sur del País *(AREQUIPA-PUNO-CUSCO-TACNA)*.

Sueldo: S/.3,000.00 - S/.3,500.00 al mes

Lugar de trabajo: Empleo presencial

jobs.title: GEOLOGO JUNIOR DE QA/QC
jobs.description:
Somos 
Minsur

jobs.title: Technical Project Coordinator (Maternity Cover)
jobs.description:
Our Opportunity

Location:
Kidlington, Oxford, Unit 5 Technology Dr,

Roster:
Monday to Friday 

Duration:
6-months (Maternity Cover, with possibility to extend) 

Overview:

This role sits within the PMO side of Programmes, helping improve Elysia’s delivery excellence, governance, tooling and project visibility, while also providing hands-on delivery support for internal technical projects.

It is ideal for someone with a technical background who enjoys improving how work gets delivered and aspires to grow into a technical Project Manager role.

You will use data, tools and process to help teams move faster, make better decisions and deliver consistently.

Key Responsibilities

You will own the consistent setup, tracking and reporting of technical projects across programmes, ensuring project information is accurate, structured and reliable.

You will work with Project Managers and technical teams to set up JIRA projects, plans, trackers, dashboards and reporting routines across Elysia’s portfolio and projects you own, providing clear visibility of project status, milestones, risks and dependencies.

A key part of the role will be improving the operations behind project delivery, making sure tools, templates and processes are efficient, useful and followed by teams.

You will help identify gaps, inconsistencies and pain points in how projects are planned and tracked, then support improvements to Elysia’s delivery processes, governance and ways of working.

At every step, you will be supported and empowered to make an impact. We are looking for someone excited to work with technical teams and improve how projects are delivered.

What will you do:
•    Support the setup of new projects in a consistent way by creating and maintaining JIRA plans, trackers, dashboards, RAID logs, risk registers and reporting routines. 
•    Own the capture and maintenance of project baselines, so current delivery status can be compared against agreed plans for portfolio reporting and SLT reviews. 
•    Maintain SLT portfolio visibility by ensuring dashboards and reports provide a clear view of project health, milestones, KPIs, budgets, risks, dependencies, resource and decisions required. 
•    Track cross-project dependencies, resource constraints, gaps and risks, escalating conflicts, trade-offs or capacity concerns where support or decisions are required. 
•    Support cross-team planning by helping ensure project plans are well integrated with Programme Managers’ wider plans, baselines and portfolio priorities. 
•    Provide PMO oversight to ensure Project Managers and Programme Managers keep plans, trackers and reports up to date as priorities, estimates, scope or delivery assumptions change.
•    Identify recurring pain points in how projects are planned, tracked and reported, then turn them into practical improvements to Elysia’s delivery processes and tools. 
•    Help ensure teams follow agreed planning, reporting and escalation processes in a way that is useful, lightweight and scalable. 
•    Support projects you own by maintaining plans, driving actions, tracking blockers and helping teams stay focused on agreed delivery outcomes. 
•    Own Jira, Confluence and project administration improvements that make project information easier to manage, report and act on. 
•    Build and sustain positive relationships with Project Managers, Programme Managers, technical teams, Commercial stakeholders and customers where relevant.

Qualifications and Experience

Our team values a growth mindset over an expansive CV. We encourage you to apply if you have some or all the following:
•    Bachelor’s degree, preferably in a STEM field such as Engineering or similar field. 
•    Experience coordinating or planning projects in a fast-paced engineering, software or product environment. 
•    Confident using modern project management and collaboration tools such as JIRA and Confluence. Experience with Structure.Gantt, Power BI or the ability to code is an advantage. This role requires experience beyond standard Office tools. 
•    Strong interest in PMO, delivery excellence, governance and process improvement. 
•    Comfortable working with project data, including plans, milestones, KPIs, budgets, risks, dependencies, actions and resource information, and able to turn it into clear plans, trackers, dashboards and reports. 
•    Well organised, detail-oriented and proactive, with strong problem-solving skills and the ability to spot gaps, inconsistencies and risks early. 
•    Able to improve processes and ways of working without making them unnecessarily heavy or bureaucratic. 
•    Comfortable working with technical teams and able to understand enough technical detail to track dependencies, blockers, progress and the impact of changes
•    Strong communication skills, with the confidence to follow up with technical, customer and commercial stakeholders, clarify information, build positive relationships and help keep teams accountable to agreed actions and deadlines. 
•    Awareness of agile, software delivery or automotive standards is preferred.

About Us

At Elysia, we are at the forefront of revolutionizing the life, safety, and performance of battery systems, across markets and industries. 

As a pioneering technology company, we specialize in the development of cutting-edge software solutions that supports, optimises and de-risks the deployment of batteries, from cradle to grave, starting with design and manufacture, through to first-life monitoring and the transition to second-life or recycling.

Our team of brilliant minds and passionate experts are dedicated to pushing the boundaries in software-derived performance, both within embedded BMS and cloud-based domains. We believe in the combination of expertise in electrochemistry, battery systems and data science to build products that empower our customers to unlock the full potential of their battery assets.

jobs.title: Senior Mine Engineer
jobs.description:
The Company

Our client is a leading company in the mining sector. Globe 24-7 Inc. has been selected as its strategic recruitment and selection partner to lead the search for a
Senior Mine Engineer.

La posición

Our client  mission is to acquire, build, operate and explore for sustainable precious metal mining operations using our proven self-perform approach, while focusing on the health and safety of our employees and host communities.
Job SummaryReporting to the Engineering Superintendent, the Senior Mine Engineer will be responsible for providing technical leadership and hands-on engineering support to both open-pit and underground mining operations. This role plays a critical part in mine planning, design, scheduling, and operational optimization from early start-up through ramp-up and steady-state operations.
The Senior Mine Engineer will act as the cross-shift counterpart to the Engineering Superintendent, ensuring continuity of engineering leadership and decision-making during the Superintendent s absences. This position requires strong technical expertise in both open-pit and underground mining, as well as the ability to operate autonomously on site.

Key Responsibilities

Mine Planning & Engineering

Conduct pit optimization for open-pit operations and stope optimization for underground mining to define economically optimal mining limits.

Estimate mineral resources, determine cut-off grades, and support mineral reserve calculations through technical analysis and economic evaluation.

Prepare detailed mine designs including pit phases, stope layouts, development plans, and production schedules.

Develop and maintain short-, medium-, and long-term mine plans aligned with production targets, cost objectives, safety standards, and regulatory requirements.

Contribute to annual mine planning, budgeting, and production forecasting.

Support the design and optimization of underground infrastructure including ramps, ventilation networks, dewatering systems, and material handling systems.

Evaluate and update mining fleet requirements and equipment replacement plans to support operational efficiency.

Operational Support & Optimization

Provide direct engineering support to site operations during commissioning, ramp-up, and steady-state production.

Collaborate with geology, mining operations, and processing teams to optimize mine design and sequencing.

Identify and implement opportunities to improve mine planning practices, sequencing, and operational efficiency.

Support the integration of new technologies, digital tools, and automation solutions within engineering processes.

Liaise with contractors, suppliers, and consultants to ensure quality and timely execution of engineering work.

Leadership & Team Development

Support the Engineering Superintendent in leading the Mine Engineering team and delivering engineering objectives.

Contribute to engineering strategy development and provide technical recommendations to the Mine Manager.

Assist in the recruitment, development, and mentoring of engineering personnel.

Communicate work objectives, priorities, and performance expectations to support production targets.

Participate in performance reviews and provide technical feedback and coaching to engineering staff.

Provide engineering leadership and decision-making support when acting on behalf of the Engineering Superintendent.

Compliance, Safety & Sustainability

Ensure engineering activities comply with company standards, Guyanese regulations, and industry best practices.

Promote and support health, safety, and environmental best practices across all engineering activities.

Identify, report, and address unsafe conditions and behaviors in accordance with company procedures.

Provide visible safety leadership to engineering teams, contractors, and site personnel to support a zero-harm culture.

Support environmental management initiatives and ensure compliance with permitting requirements.

Requirements 
Experience

Experience supporting greenfield mining project development and operational ramp-up is highly desirable.

Strong project coordination and leadership skills within multidisciplinary teams.

Proficiency in mining software such as Deswik, GEOVIA Whittle, Datamine, Hexagon (MinePlan/MineSight), Surpac, or Civil 3D.

Experience with underground mine infrastructure including ventilation, dewatering, and power distribution systems.

Knowledge of applicable mining regulations and operational standards.

Demonstrated ability to work autonomously in a site-based environment while supporting management and operational teams.

Education / Certification / Designation

Bachelor s degree in Mining Engineering (Master s degree considered an asset).

8–12 years of mining operation and engineering experience.

Required Behavioural Skills

Strategic Thinking & Global Focus: Understands long-term objectives and aligns engineering strategies accordingly.

Stakeholder Relationship Management: Builds and maintains strong relationships with internal and external partners.

Personal Leadership & Accountability: Demonstrates integrity, initiative, and commitment to continuous improvement.

Team Development & Culture Building: Invests in team growth through coaching, engagement, and development initiatives.

Operational Excellence: Drives efficiency and innovation through structured execution and accountability.

Working Conditions the Senior Mine Engineer position will be a rotation-based role, offering flexibility in scheduling to accommodate the successful candidate s location and personal preferences.

Compensation

The Company will provide an attractive compensation and benefits package.

Contact Us

Please send your CV, preferably as a Microsoft Word document.

jobs.title: HR Generalist
jobs.description:
HR Generalist

Sukari is located approximately 750km from Cairo and 25km from Marsa Alam on the Red Sea. First gold was poured in June 2009 and commercial production began in April 2010, making Sukari the first modern gold mine in Egypt, a country which in ancient times was a prolific producer of the precious metal. Sukari conducts both open-pit and underground mining operations, each employing specialised mining methods tailored to the orebody characteristics and operational requirements.

The Role

AngloGold Ashanti is seeking an HR Generalist for Sukari Gold Mine in Egypt. The role provides support to the HR Business Partners and the wider HR team across day-to-day human resources activities.
The HR Generalist supports personnel policy guidance, benefits administration, onboarding, training coordination, payroll support, employee records, reporting, and employee relations matters. The role also works closely with HR Business Partners on staffing needs, talent management processes, and maintaining employee morale and company culture.

Location: Sukari Gold Mine Egypt

Contract Type: Full Time

Schedule: 20/10 roster travelling from POH

The Key Responsibilities

HR Support: Support the HR Business Partners with day-to-day activities and respond to HR-related inquiries promptly.

Policies and Compliance: Provide personnel policy and procedure guidance to employees and management, and maintain up-to-date knowledge of employment law and compliance requirements.

Benefits and Payroll: Coordinate enrollments, changes, and training for employee benefits programs, and assist with payroll processing as required.

Expat Administration: Handle expat staff work permit procedures and visas, ensuring deadlines are met.

Training and Onboarding: Market available training in line with the training needs plan, coordinate requested training, and administer new employee onboarding, induction, and orientation.

Employee Relations and Records: Process complaints, assist with investigations and disciplinary actions, maintain personnel records, and conduct exit interviews where required.

Reporting and Workforce Support: Support the preparation of the monthly HR report, ensure data integrity, monitor employee morale and company culture, and work with HR Business Partners on future staffing needs.

The Requirements

BSc degree in Human Resources, Labour Law, or a relevant field

2 to 3 years of experience in a Generalist or Specialist role

Experience in training and/or prior recruiting would be an advantage

Proficiency in the use of social media and job boards

Proven ability to complete the full training cycle

Familiarity with HITS or a similar HRIS

Good command of English

Reporting skills

Strong communication skills

Excellent organizational skills

Microsoft Office proficiency in Word, PowerPoint, and Excel

Teamwork

Responsibility and ownership

Trustworthiness and ethics

jobs.title: Asesor(a) de Planificación Comercial - Temporal
jobs.description:
Anglo American, en sociedad con la Corporación Mitsubishi, está desarrollando la operación minera Quellaveco, uno de los yacimientos de cobre más grandes del mundo, localizado en la región de Moquegua, al sur del Perú.

Quellaveco tendrá una vida de reservas de 30 años. Utilizará proceso minero de tajo abierto y flotación para producir concentrados de cobre, así como molibdeno y plata como subproductos. Se espera que Quellaveco produzca en promedio 300 mil toneladas de cobre por año en sus primeros 10 años de operación.

En Anglo American nuestra estrategia es asegurar y desarrollar Quellaveco aplicando prácticas y tecnologías innovadoras que confiamos a nuestra gente. Estamos comprometidos a convertirnos en socios para el futuro, operar con seguridad, sustentabilidad y responsabilidad.

En Anglo American nos encontramos en búsqueda de un(a)
Asesor de Planificación Comercial
para nuestro equipo de
Supply Chain.

Tendrá la responsabilidad de Desarrollar y gestionar el proceso de planificación comercial de la cadena de abastecimiento, alineando la demanda operativa, los presupuestos, y las estrategias de contratación y compras, con el fin de apoyar la toma de decisiones estratégicas con análisis y proyecciones confiables y ser el ancla estratégica entre Supply Chain y el equipo de Finanzas.

Funciones principales

Liderar el proceso de planificación comercial anual y metas de ahorro, coordinando la recopilación, validación y consolidación de requerimientos de bienes, servicios y contratos de todas las áreas usuarias (mina, planta, mantenimiento, etc.).

Integrar la planificación de compras y contratos con el ciclo presupuestal (Opex/Capex).

Facilitar el modelamiento de escenarios de gasto y consumo. Desarrollar modelos de proyección de gasto mensual, trimestral y anual basados en tendencias históricas, contratos vigentes, consumo estimado y planes operativos.

Monitorear el cumplimiento de la planificación frente a la ejecución real (requerimientos vs. compras vs. contratos vs. consumo).

Gestionar el portafolio de requerimientos y su alineación con el presupuesto y las metas de ahorro

Identificar desvíos y proponer acciones correctivas o ajustes contractuales y/o presupuestales.

Consolidar información y reportes ejecutivos. Elaborar dashboards e informes ejecutivos para la gerencia de Supply Chain, Finanzas y otras áreas de dirección.

Asegurar trazabilidad y consistencia de la información comercial del área.

Apoyar procesos de toma de decisiones estratégicas brindando análisis cuantitativo y cualitativo

Participar en la preparación de presentaciones para directorio, auditorías o comités ejecutivos.

Funciones y responsabilidades SHE

Conocer y aplicar los valores, principios y la Política SHE de Anglo American Quellaveco y contribuir a su visión de cero daños

Asegurar que las medidas de control para los peligros y riesgos de SHE, relacionadas con las actividades a desempeñar, se encuentren implementadas en el lugar de trabajo, para el desarrollo de una labor segura.

Cumplir los estándares, procedimientos y reglamentos internos del Sistema de Gestión; así como participar activamente en las reuniones de capacitación, concientización y formación de la cultura de Cero Daños.

Reportar oportunamente los actos y condiciones inseguras; así como los Incidentes.

Formación académica e idioma

Bachiller o titulado(a) en Administración de empresas, Ingenierías, Finanzas, Economía o afines.

Indispensable inglés a nivel intermedio o avanzado (capaz de sostener conversaciones).

Trayectoria laboral

Al menos 5 años de experiencia laboral en gestión y planificación de demanda (cadena de abastecimiento) en sectores retail, banca, consumo masivo, minería, hidrocarburos, energía o afines.

Competencias SHE

Conocimiento y experiencia en la Gestión de la Seguridad, Salud y Medio Ambiente, considerando la normativa legal vigente aplicable al sector minero.

Conocimiento y experiencia en investigación de incidentes.

Conocimiento y experiencia para identificar peligros y riesgos de SHE y proponer controles efectivos

Sobre el rol

Contrato: Temporal por reemplazo de periodo de maternidad (diciembre 2026 a julio 2027)

Reporta a: Gerente de Desempeño de Cadena de Abastecimiento

Sistema: 5x2 híbrido (2 días presencial y 3 remoto)

Ubicación: San Isidro - Lima

Cierre de convocatoria

Domingo 13 de septiembre

Siguientes pasos

De continuar a la siguiente etapa, recibirá un correo por parte de nosotros invitándolo a completar su primera evaluación en nuestra plataforma HireVue y un formulario de datos en Ms Forms. Agradeceremos estar muy atento a su bandeja de entrada o de correo no deseados, a fin de continuar con cada una de las etapas de nuestro proceso dentro de los tiempos establecidos.

¡Contamos contigo para cumplir nuestro propósito: Re-imaginar la minería para mejorar la vida de las personas!

jobs.description:
Somos 
Minsur 
tercer productor de estaño a nivel mundial y el mayor proveedor de este mineral en el hemisferio occidental. Trabajamos bajo una visión de clase mundial, siendo referentes a nivel nacional e internacional en la aplicación de los lineamientos más importantes en términos de seguridad, eficiencia operacional, responsabilidad socioambiental y desarrollo de talento. Formamos parte de Breca, uno de los grupos empresariales más sólidos e importantes del Perú y somos la primera empresa minera peruana en ingresar al ICMM (Consejo Internacional de Minería y Metales). Brindar soporte en la ejecución de las actividades del área de Comunicaciones, con especial énfasis en el frente de comunicación social, contribuyendo al fortalecimiento de la estrategia de comunicación externa de las unidades operativas y proyectos de exploración.

Apoyar en la preparación y coordinación de actividades de comunicación y relacionamiento con grupos de interés, considerando las características y necesidades de los públicos involucrados.

Brindar soporte operativo y administrativo para la ejecución y seguimiento de las acciones de comunicación, coordinando requerimientos, materiales, proveedores y entregables.

Deseable experiencia en prácticas, voluntariados, proyectos universitarios o iniciativas vinculadas a comunicación social, comunitaria, institucional o estratégica

Egresado/a de las carreras de Comunicación, Comunicación Social, Comunicación para el Desarrollo o afines.

jobs.title: Head of Procurement - Fortescue Zero
jobs.description:
Our Opportunity

The Power of Now

Fortescue Zero is at the forefront of advanced engineering and technology, developing high-voltage power systems, advanced battery software and electrification solutions for some of the world’s most demanding applications.

Our technology and engineering expertise extends across heavy industry, defense and elite motorsport, with involvement in global championships including Formula 1, Formula E, IMSA and the World Endurance Championship.

An exciting opportunity has arisen to help shape the contract and procurement capability that will support Fortescue Zero as it continues to innovate, grow and scale.

About the role

This role will lead the contracts and procurement function across Fortescue Zero, shaping the capability, supplier landscape and sourcing strategies required to support a fast-growing technology business.

This is an opportunity to build and transform capability, leading a global team and working across a broad supplier network.  You will have significant influence over how Fortescue Zero sources, negotiates and delivers the parts, goods and services required by our product and programme teams.

The role requires strategic procurement leadership with hands-on commercial judgement, you will help the business scale while improving cost, quality, delivery, governance, and supplier performance.

What you will do

Lead the strategic direction and performance of Fortescue Zero’s global procurement function, building the capability required to support a rapidly evolving technology business

Develop and execute procurement, sourcing, category, and supplier strategies aligned to current and future product and programme requirements

Lead key supplier relationships and complex commercial negotiations, ensuring the right outcomes across cost, quality, delivery, and risk

Oversee procurement performance and governance across major programmes, proactively managing supplier, commercial, quality, and schedule risks

Drive continuous improvement across procurement systems, data, analytics, and processes to improve efficiency, transparency, and decision-making

Provide trusted commercial and procurement leadership to program and group levels, executives and the Board, supporting strategic decisions and business growth

About you

Significant senior leadership experience across procurement, supply chain, commercial or related functions within the automotive, mining, industrial, heavy engineering, defence, aerospace or a related sector

Have led large teams and substantial purchasing portfolios, with proven ability to build, scale or transform procurement capability within a growth-oriented, dynamic organisation

Strong track record of complex supplier negotiations, commercial decision-making, program sourcing strategies, and supplier management

Strong commercial judgement and experience managing supplier, contractual, cost, delivery, and business risk

Credibility operating at executive level, with the ability to influence senior stakeholders and present effectively to C-suite and Board audiences

Relevant degree-level qualification, with experience of procurement technology platforms and professional procurement qualifications highly regarded

About Us

Be part of something big. Fortescue is leading the world with our plan to decarbonise our iron ore operations, projects that harness renewable energy and the development of technology that will change our planet forever.

Our Commitment

Fortescue celebrates individual strengths and team members are encouraged to bring their whole selves to work. Our global workforce drives and promotes an inclusive culture, both within our organisation and throughout the communities we interact with. Diverse backgrounds include First Nations Peoples, people with disabilities, LGBTQ+ community, gender, neurodiverse, cultural diversity, all age groups, and those with an intersectional or multiple diverse characteristics. 
We encourage candidates from all backgrounds to apply.

https://fortescue.com/careers

Internal Candidates / Current Contractors please apply via Success Factors Careers Portal. For further information on how to apply please visit the Fortescue Hub. 

Fortescue reserves the right to close applications early should a suitable pool of candidates be identified. Fortescue will never contact you to ask for payment of any kind, whether directly or through a third party.

jobs.description:

EC I Supervisor ( FIFO / Thermal / Generator / Mining / Caterpillar ) West Africa

Job Reference:
453 26 02 MNW

Western Africa

Posted 2 years ago

Job Description:

Our client, a flexible energy solutions provider,ere is seeking a EC&I Supervisor who will join their team in West Africa. The EC&I Supervisor is responsible for overseeing all electrical maintenance activities at the Thermal Power Plant, ensuring the seamless operation of low-voltage (LV), medium-voltage (MV), and high-voltage (HV) systems. This role ensures the proper integration of electrical equipment from generators to transformers, including cabling, switchgear, protection systems, and communication networks.

Responsibilities:

Electrical System Maintenance & Operation

Supervise and execute electrical maintenance for LV, MV, and HV systems, ensuring uninterrupted power supply.

Oversee the proper integration of generators, transformers, cabling, switchgear, and protection systems.

Ensure safe operation and maintenance of electrical infrastructure, adhering to industry standards and plant requirements.

Monitor electrical outputs, voltage regulation, and power distribution to optimize plant performance.

Troubleshoot electrical faults, relay coordination issues, and protection system failures.

Inspections, Risk Assessments & Reporting

Conduct daily electrical system inspections to identify risks, faults, or potential failures.

Analyze operating statistics and generate reports on power system performance, failures, and required corrective actions.

Prepare and submit daily, weekly, and monthly reports on system health, maintenance activities, and improvement plans.

Ensure compliance with safety regulations, company policies, and client requirements.

Power System Integration & Optimization

Oversee the integration of battery storage, solar, and generator systems to maintain grid stability.

Ensure proper synchronization of multiple power sources to maintain continuous and reliable energy supply.

Optimize electrical systems to enhance power efficiency, load balancing, and grid stability.

Switchgear & Protection System Management

Maintain and troubleshoot switchgear, circuit breakers, transformers, relays, and motor control centres (MCCs).

Conduct relay protection testing, fault analysis, and coordination studies to prevent electrical failures.

Ensure correct settings and calibration of electrical protection devices to safeguard plant equipment.

Team Leadership & Supervision

Supervise and mentor the Electrician, ensuring compliance with maintenance schedules and best practices.

Assign tasks, provide technical guidance, and oversee the installation, testing, and maintenance of electrical systems.

Foster a safety-first culture among electrical maintenance personnel, ensuring adherence to PPE and lockout/tagout (LOTO) procedures.

Safety & Compliance

Ensure full compliance with electrical safety standards, including ISO, NFPA 70E, IEC, and local regulatory requirements.

Implement preventive maintenance programs to reduce risks of electrical failures or fire hazards.

Conduct arc flash analysis, grounding system inspections, and insulation resistance testing. 

Requirements

:

Qualification and Skill

5+ years on maintenance of power generators, preferably in a FIFO environment.

Experience on CAT MAK CM32 or similar is required.

Benefits and Contractual information:

Expatriate FIFO Contract

BACK

Maintenance Technician ( FIFO / Thermal / Generator / Mining / Caterpillar ) West Africa

Job Reference:
452 26 02 MNW

Western Africa

Posted 2 years ago

Job Description:

Our client, a flexible energy solutions provider,ere is seeking a Maintenance Technician who will join their team in West Africa. The Maintenance Technician is responsible for executing both planned (preventive) and reactive (corrective) maintenance on the balance of plant (BOP) and generators at the Goulamina Thermal Power Plant. This role requires a high level of technical proficiency to ensure all maintenance procedures are carried out to a high standard, ensuring the longevity of equipment and reliability of power supply to meet client expectations.

Responsibilities:

Preventive & Corrective Maintenance

Execute scheduled preventive maintenance on generators, pumps, fuel systems, cooling systems, and other BOP equipment.

Carry out reactive maintenance to resolve equipment failures and breakdowns efficiently.

Conduct routine inspections of plant equipment to detect early signs of wear, leaks, overheating, or malfunctions.

Ensure all maintenance activities are performed in accordance with manufacturer guidelines, safety procedures, and industry standards.

Follow precise maintenance schedules and checklists to avoid operational disruptions.

Spare Parts & Component Inspection

Inspect all spare parts and components before installation to verify their condition and compatibility.

Ensure worn-out or defective parts are properly documented and reported for replacement.

Maintain accurate records of parts used, replaced, or needing reorder to ensure smooth inventory management.

Work closely with the storeman to ensure that necessary spare parts are available for maintenance tasks.

Technical Proficiency & Troubleshooting

Use diagnostic tools and equipment to assess system performance and identify faults.

Assist in troubleshooting mechanical, hydraulic, and fuel system issues affecting engine performance.

Identify and suggest improvements to maintenance procedures and equipment modifications.

Documentation & Reporting

Accurately complete maintenance logs, checklists, and service records for each task performed.

Report any irregularities, equipment malfunctions, or safety concerns to the Maintenance Supervisor.

Participate in root cause analysis (RCA) for major breakdowns, providing technical input on possible causes.

Safety & Compliance

Adhere to strict safety regulations and procedures, including lockout/tagout (LOTO) protocols.

Ensure the correct use of personal protective equipment (PPE) at all times.

Identify and report potential hazards in the workplace to improve plant safety.

Follow environmental guidelines for handling lubricants, fuels, and waste disposal.

Requirements

:

Qualification and Skill

5+ years on maintenance of power generators, preferably in a FIFO environment.

Experience on CAT MAK CM32 is required.

Benefits and Contractual information:

Expatriate FIFO Contract

Chief Mine Geologist (Mining / Geology / Exploration / Mineral Resources) Sierra Leone

Job Reference:
AR013

Western Africa

Posted 9 months ago

Chief Mine Geologist (Mining / Geology / Mining Geology / Mineral Resources / Open Pit / Bulk Commodities) – Sierra Leone

Reference Number: AR013

Job Description:

One of our Global leading clients based in the Northern Province of Sierra Leone is in search for a Chief Mine Geologist to join their team. The role

requires managing all geological functions on a mine, including resource evaluation, geological modeling, and mine planning support. Oversees exploration programs, ensures compliance with reporting standards (SAMREC/JORC), and maintains geological databases and more.

Responsibilities:

Leadership & Team Management:
Lead, mentor, and manage geologists, technicians, and contractors; oversee daily geological activities aligned with mine plans.

Grade Control:
Ensure accurate sampling, logging, and ore-waste delineation; maintain ore quality for processing.

Resource & Reserve Estimation:
Supervise data collection and interpretation for resource modeling; assist with JORC/NI 43-101 compliant reporting.

Geological Modelling:
Manage geological models using Surpac, Leapfrog, or Vulcan; produce block models and reconciliations.

Reporting:
Generate regular geological reports and provide insights for production and planning.

Exploration & Drilling:
Design and manage near-mine exploration and infill drilling programs; integrate new data into operational plans.

Compliance & Safety:
Ensure geological operations meet safety, environmental, and statutory requirements; promote a safety-first culture.

Stakeholder Collaboration:

Our client is seeking an accomplished Group Finance Director to lead the Group's strategic finance function during a significant phase of growth and project development. This is a high-profile executive leadership role with a strong focus on capital raising, funding strategy, treasury management and financial governance, supporting the successful delivery of a large-scale mining project.

Working closely with the Executive Leadership Team, Board and key financial stakeholders, the successful candidate will be responsible for developing and executing the Group's funding strategy, leading debt and equity financing initiatives, managing banking and investor relationships, and optimising the Group's capital structure. Oversee cross-border tax strategy and compliance.

Develop financial models, budgeting, and forecasting, with clear risk visibility to the Board.

Provide financial due diligence and valuation support for investment decisions.

:

Chartered Accountant (CA, ACCA, or equivalent).

Deep understanding of treasury, IFRS, and cross-border tax and compliance frameworks, including international audit and regulatory requirements.

Experience managing multi-currency portfolios and funding operations in emerging markets, with strong currency exposure and liquidity risk management skills.

Excellent leadership, communication, negotiation, and analytical skills.

Strong commitment to integrity, transparency, professionalism, and high ethical standards.

Adaptive and decisive in dynamic financial environments.

BACK

Senior Geologist (Exploration / Copper / Structural Geology / Discovery / Mining) Angola

Job Reference:
085-2007KV

Southern Africa

Posted 2 months ago

Reference Number: 085-2007KV

Job Description:

Our client is seeking an experienced Senior Geologist to provide technical leadership for district-scale exploration programmes targeting sediment-hosted copper and magmatic nickel systems. The successful candidate will be responsible for integrating multidisciplinary geoscientific datasets, developing robust geological models, generating and prioritising exploration targets, and delivering technically sound exploration programmes from concept through drill testing. The role combines technical geoscientific leadership with disciplined operational execution, ensuring the safe, efficient and effective delivery of remote exploration programmes while working closely with technical specialists, contractors, government stakeholders and joint venture partners to achieve Discovery objectives.

Responsibilities:

Lead district-scale exploration programmes from concept generation through drill testing to support Discovery objectives.

Integrate geological, structural, geophysical and geochemical datasets to develop robust geological models and exploration targets.

Generate, evaluate and prioritise exploration targets using sound geoscientific interpretation and mineral systems thinking.

Develop exploration strategies, work programmes, budgets and schedules aligned with project objectives.

Plan, supervise and optimise drilling programmes, including target definition, logging, sampling and QA/QC.

Ensure the integrity, quality and governance of geological data, databases and exploration information.

Prepare and present high-quality technical reports, geological interpretations and presentations to technical and executive stakeholders.

Coordinate multidisciplinary technical inputs from geology, geophysics, geochemistry and external consultants.

Manage exploration contractors, laboratories and service providers to ensure safe, efficient and cost-effective programme delivery.

Monitor exploration budgets, forecasts and project performance to achieve technical and commercial objectives.

Identify, assess and mitigate technical, operational and project risks throughout the exploration lifecycle.

Build and maintain effective relationships with internal stakeholders, government authorities, joint venture partners and local communities.

Promote safe, environmentally responsible and compliant exploration practices in line with company standards.

Mentor and develop Project Geologists and Discovery Geologists while fostering a collaborative, high-performing technical team.

Drive Discovery outcomes through technical geoscientific leadership, disciplined operational execution and continuous improvement.

Qualifications, Experience & Competencies

Bachelor's Degree in Geology, Geosciences or related discipline (essential).

Minimum 10 years' exploration geology experience, including at least 3 years in a field leadership role.

Proven experience planning and executing multidisciplinary exploration programmes.

Strong understanding of sediment-hosted copper mineral systems and economic geology.

Demonstrated experience integrating geological, structural, geophysical and geochemical datasets.

Strong geological mapping, interpretation and target generation capability.

Experience with geological modelling software including Leapfrog, Micromine or equivalent.

Advanced GIS capability (ArcGIS Pro preferred).

Experience with acQuire, ioGAS or equivalent geological database systems (advantageous).

BACK

Financial Controller (Mining / Finance Leadership / IFRS / Taxation) South Africa

Job Reference:
DGS-021

Southern Africa

Posted 1 month ago

Reference Number: DGS-021

Job Description:

Our client, a leading mining company in South Africa, is seeking an experienced and commercially focused Financial Controller to join their leadership team.

The successful candidate will be responsible for leading the finance function by ensuring accurate financial and management reporting, maintaining robust financial controls, overseeing taxation and regulatory compliance, and providing strategic financial support to operational and executive management. The role will also drive budgeting, forecasting, integrated business planning, Life of Mine (LOM) evaluations, financial modelling, and continuous improvement initiatives.

This is an excellent opportunity for a finance professional with strong mining industry experience to contribute to the financial performance and long-term success of a major mining operation in South Africa.

Responsibilities:

Ensure timely and accurate reporting of financial results to corporate management, shareholders, lenders, and regulatory authorities.

Manage month-end and year-end close processes and ensure the integrity of financial reporting.

Lead the preparation and review of annual financial statements in accordance with IFRS and company policies.

Coordinate external audits and support all statutory reporting requirements.

Oversee general ledger integrity, balance sheet reconciliations, and financial controls to safeguard company assets and ensure reporting accuracy.

Provide financial analysis and insights to support operational and strategic decision-making.

Partner with mine management, engineering, geology, processing, and operational teams to support business performance and reporting requirements.

Lead the annual Integrated Business Planning process across mining, processing, maintenance, exploration, and administration functions, including budgeting and forecasting activities.

Monitor budget performance, investigate significant variances, and support cost optimisation initiatives.

Lead the financial component of Life of Mine (LOM) planning and long-term financial modelling activities.

Collaborate with technical services, geology, mine planning, and operations teams to align financial assumptions with production plans.

Evaluate project economics, including NPV, IRR, payback periods, and long-term cash flow projections.

Conduct sensitivity analyses relating to commodity prices, operating costs, grade profiles, recovery rates, and capital investments.

Support strategic planning processes, feasibility studies, expansion projects, acquisitions, and business development opportunities.

Ensure compliance with all direct and indirect tax obligations, including corporate income tax, provisional tax, royalties, transfer pricing, and deferred tax accounting requirements.

Manage relationships with tax authorities, external auditors, and tax advisors.

Monitor changes in tax legislation and assess the impact on the business.

Ensure compliance with corporate governance requirements and company policies.

Support internal audit engagements and implement audit recommendations.

Drive continuous improvement initiatives within the finance function.

Lead, mentor, and develop finance team members to achieve departmental objectives.

Promote a culture of accountability, continuous improvement, and business partnership.

Build strong working relationships with operational, technical, and corporate stakeholders.

Requirements: Qualification and Skills

Bachelor's Degree in Accounting, Finance, Commerce, or a related discipline.

Professional accounting qualification such as CA(SA), ACCA, CPA, CIMA, or equivalent will be highly advantageous.

8–10 years of progressive finance experience.

Minimum 3–5 years in a senior finance leadership role within the mining sector.

Strong knowledge of IFRS, taxation, financial reporting, budgeting, forecasting, and mining industry financial practices.

Proven experience in mine costing, financial modelling, and Life of Mine planning.

Experience evaluating capital projects and preparing investment analyses.

Strong understanding of corporate governance, risk management, and internal controls.

Experience managing external audits, tax compliance, and statutory reporting requirements.

Advanced financial modelling, analytical, and reporting capabilities.

Strong stakeholder management and leadership skills.

Excellent communication, presentation, and interpersonal skills.

High attention to detail with the ability to meet tight deadlines in a dynamic operational environment.

Demonstrated commitment to continuous improvement and business partnering.

If you wish to apply for the position, please send your CV to dscholtemeyer@camining.com

Central Africa

Posted 4 weeks ago

Reference Number:
CV185

Job Description:

We are partnering with a major international mining group to appoint a Processing Lead to deliver the new processing plant at the heart of a large copper expansion project in Central Africa. Reporting to the Processing Manager and leading a team of five to six, you will own the end-to-end delivery of the plant, from the project execution plan through engineering, procurement, construction, commissioning and ramp-up to final handover to operations, on time, within budget and to specification. This is a delivery leadership role for someone who has built and commissioned processing plants on major international projects and can hold scope, cost and schedule while managing contractors, risk and stakeholders on the ground. On completion of the plant, the role transitions to operations or to the next phase of the expansion project.

Responsibilities:

Lead delivery of the new processing plant, executing in accordance with the approved scope, budget and schedule.

Develop and implement the Project Execution Plan (PEP) across engineering, procurement and logistics, construction, risk management, document control and QA/QC.

Manage the processing plant budget, strictly controlling expenditure and ensuring cost-effectiveness.

Establish and maintain a detailed project schedule, monitoring key deliverables and milestones to ensure timely completion.

Lead tendering and award of major equipment and construction contracts, and oversee contractor performance and variations.

Own and maintain the processing plant risk register, developing and implementing mitigation strategies.

Coordinate on-site construction resources, ensuring efficient workflow and strict adherence to safety standards.

Secure the necessary permits, licences and statutory approvals, ensuring compliance with all relevant codes and regulations.

Organise and oversee plant commissioning, ramp-up and final handover to operations, coordinating operational readiness.

Build and lead a cohesive team, driving skills transfer and performance against individual and functional targets.

Requirements: Qualification and Skill

A degree in a relevant engineering or technical discipline; a Master’s and a PMP (or equivalent project-management certification) are advantageous.

15+ years across multiple international industrial and processing projects, with strong EPC (engineering, procurement and construction) management.

Experience as Engineering, Study or Project Manager on at least three international copper projects; copper or gold processing experience preferred.

A proven track record delivering processing plants through construction, commissioning, ramp-up and handover to operations.

Strong commercial, contracts and tendering acumen, with disciplined schedule, cost and risk management.

The ability to build and lead high-performing, multicultural teams on a remote site.

Excellent stakeholder management, communication and influencing skills, including with government and regulatory bodies.

Fluent English is essential; Mandarin/Chinese is advantageous given the ownership and project environment.

A valid international driving licence.

Rotational FIFO roster, set by point of hire (typically 6 weeks on / 2–3 weeks off for South African and other international hires)

jobs.description:
