BACK

Chief Geologist (Resource Estimation / Feasibility / OP / Open-Pit / Copper / Mining) Southern Africa

Job Reference:
DSS02 - OC

Southern Africa

Posted 2 weeks ago

Reference:

DSS02 OC

Job Description:

A client of ours is looking for a Chief Geologist to lead the geological function for a copper development project, which is progressing from PEA into the PFS phase and ultimately towards DFS, financing and production. The project has significant resource extension and near-mine exploration potential. The Chief Geologist will provide senior geological leadership across exploration, resource development, feasibility, and production, while overseeing the geological model, resource database, grade control, and production geology to ensure a consistent and well-characterised ore supply throughout the mine’s life.

Responsibilities:

Manage the geological database and ensure the integrity of drillhole, assay, geological, and QA/QC data.

Lead geological interpretation, 3D geological modelling, and mineral resource estimation in line with JORC, NI 43-101, or SAMREC standards.

Plan and manage exploration, infill, extension, geotechnical, and grade control drilling programmes.

Oversee core logging, sampling, QA/QC, and data quality across all drilling activities.

Lead grade control and production geology activities, ensuring accurate ore/waste delineation and consistent ore supply to the processing plant.

Integrate grade control and production data into resource models and conduct regular mine-to-mill reconciliation.

Provide geological input into short-, medium-, and long-term mine planning, PFS, DFS, and pit optimisation.

Manage geotechnical and hydrogeological monitoring programmes and provide geological input into pit stability and dewatering strategies.

Develop and manage near-mine and regional exploration programmes focused on resource replacement and growth.

Prepare and review technical reports, resource statements, regulatory submissions, and investor documentation.

Lead, mentor, and develop the geology team while promoting strong technical, safety, and environmental standards.

Ensure all geological and exploration activities comply with applicable reporting, mining, HSE, and environmental requirements.

Requirements

:

Qualification and Skill

Bachelor’s degree or higher in Geology, Geological Sciences, or a related field.

At least 10 years’ mining industry experience, including a minimum of 5 years in a senior geological position within base metals, preferably copper.

Strong expertise in geological modelling and mineral resource estimation using Leapfrog Geo, Vulcan, Datamine, or similar software.

Extensive open-pit geology experience, with a strong background in grade control, production geology, drilling programs, ore block definition, and mine-to-mill reconciliation.

Proven ability to manage geological teams and drilling programs across greenfield and brownfield mining projects.

Good knowledge of JORC 2012, NI 43-101, or SAMREC reporting requirements.

Strong understanding of copper deposit geology, including supergene and hypogene mineralisation and structural controls.

Experience supporting a mining project through a PEA-to-PFS or PFS-to-DFS transition.

Working knowledge of geotechnical and slope monitoring technologies, including slope radar, LiDAR, and UAV photogrammetry, with an understanding of geological and hydrogeological influences on pit stability.

jobs.title: Supervisor, Maintenance
jobs.description:
Elk Valley Resources (EVR) operates four steelmaking coal mines that employ over 5,000 people in the Elk Valley of British Columbia. We are committed to responsible resource development, environmental performance and building strong partnerships with communities and Indigenous Peoples.

EVR is proud to be part of the Glencore Group, contributing to a global portfolio of operations with a history that dates back more than 100 years in Canada

.

Are you looking for a new career opportunity? Join our team.

Application Deadline:

September 22nd

What we offer:

At EVR, we're dedicated to supporting our workforce on their unique career journeys.

EVR recognizes our employees' skills, competencies, and performance and offers opportunities with competitive compensation and benefits. We also aim to promote employee health and wellness and provide opportunities for professional development.

We believe in the power of diversity and strive each day to create a workplace where each individual is valued and respected for their contributions.

We also believe that our employees are the reason we are accomplishing great things and are committed to supporting them through our many different programs.

About the role:

Reporting to the Superintendent, Maintenance, the Maintenance Supervisor will be responsible for all maintenance activities in the shop and pit. This position combines the responsibilities for trades, schedule execution, continuous improvement, and staffing to ensure company standards are maintained. This position follows a 4x4 rotating schedule, alternating between two-day shifts and two-night shifts.

To be successful, we are looking for someone with excellent organizational, interpersonal and communication skills, who can coordinate the efforts of others to accomplish objectives. The successful individual will thrive in a fast-paced environment with minimal direction and work well collaborating with a team. We are looking for someone with strong problem solving and decision-making abilities, who is passionate about technology and continuous improvement.

Join us in the breathtaking Elk Valley of British Columbia. Here you will find outdoor adventure at your fingertips. Whether it's biking and skiing, or the laid-back atmosphere of fishing and hiking, there is something for everyone! Come experience what work life balance is all about!

Two Annual Bonus Plans

Comprehensive Benefits Plan

Retirement Package

Health Lifestyle Account

Relocation Assistance

Participate in and adhere to health and safety programs and policies

Direct the troubleshooting of equipment failures to determine root cause and initiate appropriate remedial action

Oversee quality maintenance and repair of mine equipment to improve availability and reliability for production

Manage daily and weekly work schedules to ensure work is complete on time and on budget through usage of Short Interval Controls and ensure Preventative Maintenance compliance

Supervise contractors and employees, improving employee work performance, efficiency, and perform performance evaluations

Follow-up on current jobs and assist trades people with troubleshooting

Assist with the development of the schedule

Assist in sourcing and requisitioning maintenance supplies, equipment, and services within budgeted guidelines

Maintain vacation schedules using Vacation Allotment guidelines, recommending, and approving overtime work

Manage Key Performance Indicators, such as downtime hours, schedule compliance, and labor factor

Trade certification, technical diploma, or degree in a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and experience

Minimum five years mining/industrial experience in maintenance and maintenance reliability in an industrial environment

Experience supervising or leading a team

Strong digital literacy and proficient in the Microsoft Office Suite®

Valid Class 5 Driver’s License or equivalent

jobs.title: Industrial Placement (2027-2028) - Software - Jaguar TCS Racing
jobs.description:
Accelerate Your Career

Jaguar TCS Racing is at the forefront of electric motorsport innovation, competing in the electrifying Formula E Championship. As part of the legendary Jaguar brand, our team is dedicated to pioneering advancements in electric vehicle technology, sustainability, and performance. With a rich heritage in racing and a commitment to pushing the boundaries of electric mobility, Jaguar TCS Racing combines passion, expertise, and cutting-edge technology to compete at the highest levels of motorsport.

We operate a 12-month (September 2027 - August 2028) student placement programme within our Formula E Car Development (Software) group. This is an exciting opportunity to work alongside highly skilled and experienced engineering professionals and graduates, offering plenty of scope to learn and develop - the more questions you ask the more you will gain from your experience. It is important to know that many of our industrial placements have been successful in obtaining graduate roles on completion of their degree.

To be eligible for an industrial placement within our Formula E Car Development (Software) group you should be working towards a degree in Software Engineering, Computer Science or a related area.

What you will do

During the placement you will take on responsibilities such as: 

Working as an integral part of the Car Development team. 

Developing a new generation of software tools, APIs, and packages using the modern .NET stack (C# - candidates do not need prior experience with the language but should be confident programmers who understand core principles and are eager to learn), cloud technologies (Azure, AWS) and containerization (Docker, WSL containers). This will support the standardisation and automation of our applications including:  

Trackside car ECU monitoring/configuration and sensor calibration 

Trackside data processing 

Cloud-based technical document management 

Cloud-based event management 

Component lifing support 

Tooling to support performance and system engineer workflows 

Supporting the development and maintenance of databases in SQL (T-SQL, Postgres) and NoSQL (MongoDB). 

Writing unit, integration and mutation tests to ensure high code quality. 

Experiment with agentic coding using cutting edge frontier AI models with generous budgets (like everyone, we’re still figuring this one out!). 

Our goal is to reduce the time it takes for engineers to make valuable performance decisions over a race weekend.

Submitting your application

When applying for industrial placements opportunities, all students are expected to submit a covering letter along with a Curriculum Vitae containing the following information: 

• Your current career aims and how you plan to achieve them. 

• Subjects that you are currently taking and plan to take. 

• Relevant leisure pursuits and activities. 

• Why work experience would be beneficial to you.

Next Steps

Those students that are shortlisted will be invited to attend an assessment.  It is expected that the student takes sole responsibility for making suitable travel and accommodation arrangements.

Our Commitment

You do not need to match every listed expectation to apply for this position. At Fortescue Zero we are committed to building a team that encompasses a variety of backgrounds, experiences and skills.  

Fortescue Zero is an equal opportunity employer who values diversity and inclusion. If you have a disability, 

We are happy to discuss reasonable job adjustments. 

Apply now »

jobs.title: Garage Technician - Jaguar TCS Racing
jobs.description:
Accelerate Your Career

Jaguar TCS Racing is at the forefront of electric motorsport innovation, competing in the electrifying Formula E Championship. As part of the legendary Jaguar brand, our team is dedicated to pioneering advancements in electric vehicle technology, sustainability, and performance. With a rich heritage in racing and a commitment to pushing the boundaries of electric mobility, Jaguar TCS Racing combines passion, expertise, and cutting-edge technology to compete at the highest levels of motorsport.

An opportunity has arisen for a Garage Technician to join the Jaguar TCS Racing department in a rapidly expanding and exciting work environment.

About the role

To provide the workshop and trackside garage technician function, in support of the Jaguar Formula E Teams daily operational goals.

What you will do

Operate as a Garage Technician both at the factory and at trackside events.

Manage the team’s wheel and tyre inventory in collaboration with Engineering, including preparation, TPMS unit fitting, and event management (session pressure adjustments, tyre running, supplier/engineering liaison).

Plan and administer team truck operations, including loading, inventory control, supplier liaison, and unit booking for events.

Maintain all team consumable stocks in liaison with Chief Mechanics, ensuring timely re-stock ordering and follow-up.

Oversee the team pit equipment and off-car hardware in liaison with Chief/#1 Mechanics, ensuring readiness, proactive daily maintenance, repairs, and correct storage.

Support the assembly and maintenance of race and test garage infrastructures, including repair and upkeep of garage equipment and packhorses.

Assist with freight operations, including organisation, packing, loading/unloading of shipments, and preparation of documentation (Carnet lists, truck inventories).

Act as the key contact for storage of pit equipment (current and historic), maintaining PDN documents and inventory records.

Ensure all Jaguar Racing workshop, race, and test locations remain organised, clean, and operationally efficient, utilising offsite storage as needed.

Escalate equipment or operational issues to management promptly.

Adhere to Jaguar Formula E and wider business processes and policies.

Comply with safety regulations at all venues.

About you

Motorsport event garage operational experience (both factory and trackside).

Experience in tyre management at race / test events, including pressure adjustments and liaison with engineers and suppliers.

Strong knowledge of race truck preparation / operation and stock keeping.

Familiarity with road and air freight operations.

A confident, self-starting team player, adaptable to the fast-paced, dynamic requirements of race and test environments.

What is in it for you?

Our UK benefits include:

Bonus scheme

Aviva Pension

Group Life Assurance

Group Income Protection

Electric Car Scheme

Health Cash Plan

Employee Assistance Programme

Private Medical Insurance

26 days holiday
plus
public holidays and the opportunity to purchase an additional 5 days per year

jobs.title: Técnico Soldador - Comas
jobs.description:
Importante taller de metalmecánica solicita un técnico soldador con disponibilidad para laborar en comas.
Misión:
Ejecutar procesos de soldadura en accesorios de diferentes tipos de materiales (acero, inoxidable) mediante técnicas de manera segura, precisa y eficiente, uniendo piezas metálicas conforme a planos, especificaciones técnicas y normas de calidad establecidos, para garantizar la resistencia, funcionalidad y durabilidad de las estructuras o productos fabricados.
Funciones del puesto:
Preparar materiales, superficies, equipos e insumos necesarios para el proceso de soldadura.
Seleccionar el proceso de soldadura, electrodos, alambres y parámetros adecuados según el tipo de material.
Operar equipos de soldadura SMAW, TIG, MIG, FCAW, entre otros.
Trabajar con diferentes tipos de metales como acero, acero inoxidable y otros materiales.
Inspeccionar la calidad de las uniones soldadas e identificar y corregir posibles defectos.
Realizar mantenimiento básico, limpieza y cuidado de los equipos y herramientas de soldadura.
Cumplir con los procedimientos de seguridad industrial y uso de EPP.
Mantener el orden y limpieza del área de trabajo y reportar cualquier falla o desviación al supervisor.
Requisitos del puesto:
Experiencia mínima de 2 años en procesos de soldaduras en plantas metalmecánicas, estructuras o minería.
Técnica y egresado en formación relacionada en soldadura.
Homologación en 3g vigente (no excluyente).
Disponibilidad para laborar en Comas.
Beneficios:
Salario acorde al mercado.
Planilla completa desde el primer día de trabajo.
Seguro EPS (opcional).
Estabilidad Laboral.
Línea de Carrera.
Eventos deportivos de integración.
Excelente Ambiente Laboral.
Modalidad de trabajo:
Lunes a Viernes: 7:00 a.m. - 5:40 p.m. - Presencial (horas extras remuneradas en caso lo requiera la operación).

jobs.description:
*SE BUSCA PINTOR NETO – MINA ÁTICO, AREQUIPA*

Importante empresa del rubro minero se encuentra en la búsqueda de un *PINTOR NETO* comprometido, responsable y con experiencia, para integrarse a nuestro equipo de trabajo en *Mina Ático – Arequipa*.

El candidato seleccionado realizará trabajos de pintura y acabado dentro de la operación minera, asegurando una correcta preparación de superficies y aplicación de pintura, con especial dominio en trabajos de *satinado*, cumpliendo con los estándares de seguridad y calidad establecidos por la empresa.

*Funciones principales:*

* Preparación y acondicionamiento de superficies antes de realizar los trabajos de pintura.

* Manejo y cuidado de herramientas y equipos utilizados en trabajos de pintura.

* Limpieza y orden del área de trabajo antes, durante y después de las actividades.
* Cumplimiento de los procedimientos y normas de seguridad establecidos en la operación minera.

*Requisitos:*

* Experiencia comprobada como pintor neto en minería o construcción.
* Contar con certificados de trabajo que acrediten su experiencia.
* Certificado Único Laboral (CUL) actualizado.
* Copia de DNI vigente.
* Buen estado físico y disposición para trabajo en altura o condiciones de mina.
* Disponibilidad inmediata.
* Experiencia y dominio en trabajos de *satinado y acabados de pintura*.

*Condiciones laborales:*

* Régimen minero: *20 días de trabajo por 10 días de descanso (20x10)*.
* Remuneración: *S/ 1,500 semanales*.
* Lugar de trabajo: *Mina Ático – Arequipa*.
* Oportunidad de continuidad laboral según desempeño.

Lugar de trabajo:Unidad minera en Ático, Arequipa

Postulación:Los interesados deberán enviar su CV documentado (adjuntando certificados de trabajo, CUL y DNI) Y/O escribenos a nuestro numero 970507566 o a nuestro correo ayledificacionescontrucciones@gmail.com indicando disponibilidad inmediata.

¡Únete a nuestro equipo y sé parte del sector minero!

jobs.title: Commercial Director
jobs.description:
Commercial Director

About the company:

In the coming decades, our world needs substantially more critical minerals such as copper, lithium, and cobalt, to build electric infrastructure, vehicles, data centers, and electronics. The mining industry is making 10x fewer discoveries per dollar spent on exploration compared to 30 years ago, because the easy-to-find, near surface deposits have largely been discovered.

KoBold is a leading scientific mineral exploration, mine development, and technology development company. Our goal is to turn mineral exploration into a repeatable science to make discoveries faster—by integrating artificial intelligence, human intelligence, and new technology. We made our first discovery—Mingomba, one of the world’s largest undeveloped high-grade copper deposits—after spending materially less than the industry average. This asset is expected to operate for decades, and be a leading global copper supplier. KoBold is actively running exploration programs in 8 countries worldwide, all with the potential for another high-quality discovery.

We are developing Mingomba by applying the same technical rigor to resource development and mine planning as we do to exploration. Mingomba is also a scientific laboratory where we prototype new technology and workflows, combined with the expertise of veteran engineers. Our multidisciplinary team consists of mine and processing engineers, geologists, data scientists, software engineers, community, health & safety, construction, and operations specialists. We want to develop world-class mining projects that are safer and have more predictable outcomes for ourselves, partners, and communities.

KoBold is privately held; investors include institutional asset managers T. Rowe Price and Canada Pension Plan Investments; technology venture capitalists Andreessen Horowitz, Breakthrough Energy Ventures, BOND Capital, Durable Capital, StepStone, and Standard Investments; and strategic natural resources companies BHP and Mitsubishi.

About the role

This is a senior Engineering leadership role for the development of a significant Copper mining complex in Zambia. The Mingomba deposit contains over 10 million tonnes of copper more than half of which exceeds 6% grade. This role will help turn that world class deposit into a world class mine.

The Commercial Director establishes the commercial strategy, contracting approach, procurement and market engagement plan, and contractor management disciplines required to deliver the Mingomba project safely, competitively, and predictably. The role owns the commercial pathway from PFS and engineering delivery through package strategy, tendering, negotiation, award, contract administration, contractor performance, transition to operations and commercial close out. The Mingomba project is expected to require capital expenditure of more than US$2 billion, so the role requires a commercial leader who has built and run major-project commercial functions before.

What this role is accountable for delivering

This role provides the strategic commercial leadership for a significant greenfield project by setting the commercial direction, developing and implementing the strategies that flow from it and building and directing the team that delivers them. The successful candidate will be measured on:

A commercial strategy — delivery model, contracting approach, market engagement, and packaging — approved through project governance, delivered on schedule, and updated as conditions change.

A capable, high performing contracting, procurement and supply chain team built, developed and directed to deliver the targets with clear accountabilities and growing local capability

Major packages tendered and awarded to the baseline schedule with no critical path slippage attributable to procurement or contract formulation

Final contract outlays within the agreed band of the approved estimate, with commitments, cost exposure and forecasts visible to the project and finance at all times.

Claims and variation exposure quantified, contained and actively managed with no material unresolved disputes at handover to operations

Local content targets met with auditable evidence of local supplier participation and capability development

A procurement and contracting function that passes independent commercial audits and stage gate review without material qualification

A clean integrity record with no sanctions, bribery or conflict of interest findings in the supply chain and contracting workflows.

Responsibilities

Commercial governance and routines: Establish the commercial policies, approval thresholds, procurement gates, contract governance, tender review cadence, award recommendations, change controls, claims controls, and vendor management routines needed to support safe, competitive, and predictable project delivery.

Project delivery model and contracting options: Develop the project delivery model and contracting strategy (EPC, EPCM, design-and-build, owner-managed, or hybrid), assessing each option against risk, cost, schedule, market capacity, local content, and value for money

Commercial leadership and decision support: Lead commercial inputs into the project, executive forums and technical committees ensuring that contracting and procurement status, market intelligence and feedback, contractor risks, cost exposure, and package readiness are visible and early enough for management action.

Interface with engineering: Partner with the Senior Engineering & Integration Manager under a defined split of authority (engineering responsible for design authority and technical bid evaluation). The Commercial Director is responsible for commercial evaluation, contract formation and administration, with a single joint change control process spanning technical and commercial impacts.

The Senior Engineering & Integration Manager is the primary technical authority for the Mingomba copper project through its design and construction phase. Reporting to the Project Director, this role carries end-to-end accountability for the quality, integrity, and integration of all engineering across the owner's team, the EPCM and specialist contractors. The role is the technical decision-maker and design authority for the project, responsible for safeguarding Kobold’s interests through stage gates, design reviews, and construction handover to operations. What this role is accountable for delivering

This role exists to ensure against common failure modes on major capital projects, with particular emphasis on scope creep driven by unresolved technical decisions, design quality that does not survive construction, and an owner's team that cannot effectively challenge or govern its engineering service providers.

The successful candidate will be judged on:

Engineering delivered on time, within sanction cost, and to the standard required for safe, operable, and maintainable facilities.

A design that has been constructability-reviewed, value-engineered, and operability-tested before it is frozen.

An EPCM that is technically directed, not just administered, with KoBold holding design authority.

A project that passes independent technical assurance reviews and stage-gate approvals without material qualification.

A technical risk register that is live, owned, and actively driven down.

Establish the basis of design, engineering standards, and design criteria for the project, and enforce them with both the owner's team and the EPCM.

Own the technical risk register: identify, quantify, and drive the resolution of engineering risks before they become scope changes or construction rework.

Approve key engineering deliverables including P&IDs, design criteria, equipment datasheets, and technical specifications.

Direct the scope freeze process: define what decisions must be made to freeze design at each stage, own the timeline for those decisions, and prevent scope growth after sanction.

Act as KoBolds senior technical interface to the EPCM as an active director of engineering scope, priorities, and performance.

Monitor engineering service provider progress against the engineering management plan using earned value metrics and escalate deviations in quality, schedule, or cost before they compound.

Direct EPCM and specialist contractor technical performance by challenging design solutions, enforcing design and lifecycle cost requirements, and proactively mitigating interface risks to ensure scope alignment.

Lead formal constructability reviews at FEL 2 and FEL 3, ensuring construction knowledge is embedded in the design before it is frozen.

Drive operability and maintainability reviews with the operations and maintenance readiness team at each design milestone, ensuring the facility can be safely operated and maintained as designed.

jobs.title: Head of ESG
jobs.description:
Globe 24-7, in partnership with a leading copper and cobalt mining company, is recruiting a Head of ESG for an expatriate leadership opportunity in the Democratic Republic of Congo.

This senior appointment will lead the development and delivery of the Company s ESG strategy across its operations, with particular responsibility for international ESG standards, lender requirements, environmental and social action plans, and ESG assurance. The successful candidate will play a critical role in strengthening the Company s ESG capability as the business enters its next phase of growth and investment, working closely with executive leadership, the Board, international lenders and external stakeholders.

The Role

The Head of ESG will lead the Company s alignment with international ESG standards, with particular focus on the IFC Performance Standards, while owning the development and delivery of the ESG roadmap across its operations.
The role will lead ESG engagement with lenders, technical advisors, independent monitors and external E&S stakeholders, translating lender requirements and independent gap assessments into practical, costed and time-bound implementation plans.
A key priority will be building the internal ESG capability required to deliver the Company s long-term objectives, while developing and managing a strong network of specialist environmental and social consultants.
The Head of ESG will work closely with the existing CSR and External Relations function, alongside HSE, HR, Procurement, Legal and Finance, to ensure effective ESG implementation and assurance across the business.
This is an expatriate opportunity in the DRC, supporting operations across Lubumbashi and Kolwezi.

The Responsibilities

Develop and drive the Company s long-term ESG strategy across its operations.

Own the IFC Performance Standards PS1-PS8 compliance roadmap and ensure effective implementation across operating sites.

Lead and manage the Environmental and Social Action Plan (ESAP), including implementation priorities, budgets, milestones, evidence requirements and close-out.

Lead ESG engagement with international lenders, lender ESG teams, technical advisors and independent engineers.

Manage lender reviews, site visits, reporting, ESAP verification and independent monitoring.

Translate lender requirements, independent assessments and identified ESG gaps into practical internal action plans.

Build, develop and lead the Company s internal ESG capability, including the recruitment and development of specialist ESG professionals.

Scope, appoint and manage specialist environmental and social consultants across key ESG workstreams.

Serve as the Company s subject matter expert on IFC Performance Standards, Equator Principles, OECD Due Diligence Guidance and the UN Guiding Principles on Business and Human Rights.

Lead the preparation, submission and regulatory approval of ESIAs, ESHIAs and associated environmental and social management plans.

Develop and implement ESG policies, procedures and management systems aligned with international standards.

Provide regular ESG reporting to executive leadership and the Board.

Partner with CSR, HSE, HR, Procurement, Legal and Finance to ensure effective ESG implementation across the organisation.

Establish and lead ESG assurance programmes, including internal audits, contractor audits and independent verification.

Support ESG requirements associated with future project finance, refinancing, offtake, equity and other strategic transactions.

Develop internal ESG capability and reduce reliance on external consultants over time.

The Requirements

Bachelor s Degree in Environmental Science, Social Science, Engineering or a related discipline.

Relevant Master s Degree preferred.

Minimum 10 years ESG and sustainability experience within the mining sector, including at least 5 years in a senior role with direct lender interface responsibility.

Extensive hands-on experience owning IFC Performance Standards PS1-PS8 compliance roadmaps from development through to implementation and close-out.

Proven experience managing ESAP delivery against lender requirements and agreed milestones.

Direct experience leading ESIA and ESHIA preparation, submissions and regulatory engagement within mining operations.

Strong experience scoping, selecting, contracting and managing specialist environmental and social consultants.

Direct lender interface experience within Equator Principles or IFC-aligned project finance, including lender reviews, site visits, independent engineer engagement and ESAP verification.

Deep working knowledge of international ESG standards and lender requirements.

Proven experience building and leading ESG teams within mining environments.

Previous experience within African mining, with exposure to the DRC or Central African Copperbelt highly advantageous.

Exposure to artisanal and small-scale mining (ASM) challenges within African mining environments.

Experience with PS5 resettlement and Livelihood Restoration Plans advantageous.

GISTM and tailings management experience advantageous.

Experience supporting ESG components of project finance, refinancing or M&A transactions advantageous.

Fluent English essential, with working French strongly preferred.

Comfortable working within an expatriate arrangement in the DRC, supporting operations across Lubumbashi and Kolwezi.

The Rewards

This is an exceptional opportunity to take ownership of the ESG agenda within an established copper and cobalt mining business during a significant period of growth and investment.

The successful candidate will have direct exposure to executive leadership, the Board, international lenders and key external stakeholders while playing a central role in strengthening the Company s ESG capability and alignment with international standards.

An attractive expatriate remuneration and benefits package will be offered to the successful candidate.

To provide composite component assembly, repair and mechanical support for the Jaguar Formula E Team.

What you will do

Primary function:

To bring the expertise, process and hands-on ability necessary to provide the Jaguar Formula E Team with composite component assembly and repair on event and at the factory.

Support the Race, Test and factory teams in their operational goals, being able to assist with other hands on team requirements as required.

Job Requirements:

Assemble, adjust, repair and disassemble the team’s composite components on event and at the factory.

Assemble / repair / maintain components, pit and garage equipment and car hardware as required.

Assemble and maintain race and test garage infrastructures and hardware both on event and when at the factory.

Provide hands on support for factory operations as required

Ideally, possess a good vehicle wrapping skillset; able to confidently wrap complex bodywork and garage infrastructure components.

Provide feedback of any component issues and problems.

Adhere to all Jag FE and wider business processes and policies.

Follow all safety regulations in all venues.

About you

Capabilities:

Adequate composite trackside assembly and on event repair experience, in a motorsport environment.

A confident team player, familiar with the fast paced and ever-changing requirements of a race and test team.

Personal Attributes / Skills:

Be able to work independently to strict deadlines as well as being a strong team player.

To be able to work under their own initiative when necessary.

To have a ‘can do’ proactive attitude and proactively support others.

Complete tasks given within agreed time frames.

Flexible attitude to working hours.

To follow and actively enforce the company’s health and Safety and HV policies.

This position may require lifting, repeated bending, squatting and manual dexterity. Fast-paced work environment requiring heavy mental demands. Work environment includes machinery, race cars, 7-post and other rigs, grinding debris, and hazardous fluids. All employees must ensure compliance with the Company Health and Safety Policy, and all relevant other statutory Health and Safety legislation.

What is in it for you?

Bonus scheme

Group Life Assurance

Group Income Protection

Electric Car Scheme

Health Cash Plan

Employee Assistance Programme

Private Medical Insurance

26 days holiday
plus

jobs.title: Material & Warehouse Operator, Junior
jobs.description:
Ausenco es una empresa de rápido crecimiento y grandes ideas. Redefinimos lo que es posible en algunos de los proyectos más complejos y entornos más difíciles del mundo. Entregamos soluciones innovadoras a través de estudios de consultoría de alto valor agregado; ejecución de proyectos; operación de activos y optimización de mantenimiento. Desde 21 oficinas en 9 países, con proyectos en más de 80 ubicaciones en todo el mundo, creamos resultados sostenibles para nuestra gente, clientes y comunidades.

Nuestro equipo en Perú está creciendo, nos encontramos reclutando profesionales para la posición de Material & Warehouse Operator, Junior para unirse a nuestra línea de negocios de Minerals & Metals en uno de nuestros principales proyectos en terreno.

Acerca del rol

Recibir y verificar materiales y equipos según guías de remisión, órdenes de compra y especificaciones técnicas, aplicando los protocolos específicos del Proyecto
Recepción de materiales y equipos de Almacén Concentradora
Despacho de los materiales y equipos recibidos
Realizar los check list en el SharePoint de los materiales y equipos recibidos
Ordenar y ubicar los materiales en los diferentes almacenes que tenemos en Site
Revisar y chequear en los diferentes almacenes la conformidad de los materiales y equipos, verificando que se encuentren debidamente cubiertos y en buen estado
Realizar un control diario de las bobinas de cables eléctricos que tenemos en los diferentes almacenes
Promover y mantener una cultura de seguridad en los almacenes bajo su responsabilidad, lo cual incluye conceptos clave como el orden y limpieza y Cero Accidentes
Mantener actualizado el sistema de control de inventario, con especial atención a materiales críticos del proyecto
Coordinar con almacenes y patios de materiales para la correcta preservación y segregación de los materiales según estándares mineros
Apoyar en la identificación de potenciales desviaciones en consumos de materiales que podrían impactar la continuidad de los trabajos
Asegurar el cumplimiento de las normativas HSEC aplicables a la manipulación y almacenamiento de materiales en minería.

Acerca de ti

Técnico construcción o Administración, Logística o carreras afines
Deseables conocimientos básicos en construcción y/o infraestructura minera
Conocimiento de sistemas de gestión de inventarios y almacenes en proyectos de gran envergadura
Mínimo 2 años en posiciones similares en proyectos de construcción para el sector minero
Experiencia deseable en manejo de sistemas ERP o software de control de materiales (SAP, Oracle, Primavera Materials)
Experiencia deseable en gestión de materiales para plantas concentradoras, sistemas de bombeo, movimiento de tierras o infraestructura minera
Manejo avanzado de Excel y herramientas ofimáticas
Experiencia en uso de SharePoint para control documental y check lists
Comprensión de procedimientos de almacenamiento y preservación de materiales en condiciones de altura o climas extremos
Conocimiento de codificación y clasificación de materiales según estándares de la industria minera
Conocimientos de seguridad industrial y prevención de riesgos en almacenes mineros

¿Por qué Ausenco?

Apoyamos el crecimiento individual y nuestro objetivo es permitirte trabajar de una manera que aproveche tus fortalezas y cubra tus necesidades. Conoce la Propuesta de Valor Ausenco:

Compensación y Beneficios: Disfruta de los beneficios de nuestras políticas de licencia incluida la licencia parental remunerada, y participa de eventos corporativos y celebraciones de fechas importantes en un ambiente de trabajo positivo y entretenido.
Crecimiento y Desarrollo: Recibe apoyo continuo en tu desarrollo personal y profesional con capacitación técnica, programas de tutoría y oportunidades frecuentes para generar redes de trabajo a nivel global.
Balance y Bienestar: Adopta un enfoque proactivo para tu bienestar general. Accede a consejería confidencial, servicios de salud y un programa de beneficios que respalden tus necesidades.
Reconocimiento y Apreciación: Participa de espacios multidireccionales donde se fomenta una cultura de reconocimiento local y global, en donde todos son reconocidos por su contribución al negocio y los proyectos.

Fortescue Zero is a global technology and engineering business with capability across electrification, battery intelligence, advanced engineering, motorsport, wind, solar and emerging applications.Our challenge is not capability. It is ensuring customers, partners and markets understand what we can do and turning that understanding into brand growth, customer demand and commercial opportunity. 

This is a broad, high-impact role spanning brand, B2B product marketing, sales enablement, content, partnerships, motorsport, events and customer engagement. We are looking for someone who combines highly creative thinking with strong commercial judgement, exceptional stakeholder management and the ability to turn ideas into measurable business outcomes.

Reporting to the Chief Technology Officer, you will own the global marketing strategy and delivery for Fortescue Zero.

You will set the creative direction, establish clear priorities and bring the full marketing programme together through one connected plan. Working closely with Fortescue Zero’s leadership, commercial, product, sales and engineering teams, you will translate complex technical capability into clear propositions, compelling stories and customer-led marketing activity.

A key part of the role will be building and leading an agile in-house marketing model. Significant senior marketing leadership experience in technology, automotive, motorsport, energy, industrial, engineering or another complex B2B environment.

A proven track record of setting creative direction and leading multidisciplinary in-house marketing or creative teams.

Experience leading integrated partnerships, sponsorships, motorsport programmes, major events, hospitality or customer activations.

Proven success influencing senior stakeholders and aligning product, commercial, sales, engineering and corporate teams around shared priorities.

Experience leading teams, budgets, internal capability, agencies and multi-market marketing programmes.

Strong commercial judgement, with the ability to connect marketing priorities to customer needs, business objectives and growth opportunities.

jobs.title: Ingeniero Electricista de Campo y Proyectos
jobs.description:
En Mafort Service S.A.C. nos encontramos en la búsqueda de un Ingeniero Electricista con un perfil eminentemente técnico-operativo y de gestión. El rol requiere capacidad para participar directamente en campo, diagnosticar problemas complejos, y coordinar equipos técnicos y proveedores en proyectos de infraestructura eléctrica crítica, UPS y bancos de baterías.

No buscamos exclusivamente un profesional de diseño o administrativo; necesitamos un ingeniero capaz de pasar de la ingeniería a la ejecución bajo la premisa: Analizar, diagnosticar, planificar, ejecutar, supervisar, documentar.

Principales Responsabilidades

Supervisar y ejecutar proyectos de instalaciones eléctricas y sistemas UPS (monofásicos y trifásicos).
Realizar levantamientos técnicos en campo y elaborar informes detallados.
Revisar planos eléctricos, diagramas unifilares, especificaciones técnicas y memorias.
Coordinar instalaciones, pruebas, puesta en marcha y mantenimiento de UPS y bancos de baterías.
Supervisar trabajos de técnicos electricistas, contratistas y personal especializado.
Ejecutar y supervisar pruebas eléctricas, de transferencia, bypass, autonomía y funcionamiento.
Realizar diagnóstico avanzado de fallas en sistemas eléctricos y UPS.
Elaborar procedimientos de trabajo, protocolos de pruebas, dossiers técnicos y documentación de cierre.
Participar en reuniones técnicas con clientes, fabricantes (ej. Vertiv) y contratistas.

Requisitos Indispensables

Formación: Titulado y Colegiado en Ingeniería Electricista o Ingeniería Mecánica Electricista (habilitación profesional según requerimiento del proyecto).
Experiencia: Mínimo 5 años de experiencia general en instalaciones eléctricas, mantenimiento eléctrico, UPS o infraestructura crítica, con experiencia sólida y comprobada en campo.
Sistemas Críticos: Deseable experiencia en Data Centers, salas eléctricas, centros de datos, sector bancario, clínicas, minería o industria.

Conocimientos técnicos sólidos:

Sistemas UPS monofásicos y trifásicos (10 kVA a 600 kVA o superiores), bypass y transferencia.
Bancos de baterías (Norma IEEE 1188 para mantenimiento y evaluación VRLA).
Tableros eléctricos, sistemas de distribución, puesta a tierra y protección.
Lectura e interpretación de planos y diagramas unifilares.
Normativa: Familiaridad con normas IEC, IEEE y NFPA.

Herramientas y Software

AutoCAD: Nivel intermedio como mínimo.
Microsoft Office: Excel intermedio, Word y PowerPoint.
Planificación: MS Project u otras herramientas de gestión (deseable).
Manejo de instrumentos de medición eléctrica.

Competencias y Habilidades

Capacidad de diagnóstico y resolución de problemas.
Liderazgo técnico en campo.
Criterio técnico para la toma de decisiones.
Comunicación efectiva con clientes y capacidad de trabajar bajo presión.
Orientación a resultados y proactividad.

Horario y Beneficios

Planilla MYPE: Todos tus beneficios de ley correspondientes.
Horario: Lunes a viernes de 9:00 a.m. a 6:00 p.m. y sábados de 9:00 a.m. a 1:00 p.m.
Disponibilidad: Para visitas técnicas, supervisiones en campo, viajes a provincias y trabajos programados según la naturaleza del proyecto.
Lugar de trabajo: Empleo presencial en surco.

4 años de experiencia
Edad: A partir de 25 años

jobs.title: Senior Engineer, Mining
jobs.description:
Elk Valley Resources (EVR) operates four steelmaking coal mines that employ over 5,000 people in the Elk Valley of British Columbia. We are committed to responsible resource development, environmental performance and building strong partnerships with communities and Indigenous Peoples.

EVR is proud to be part of the Glencore Group, contributing to a global portfolio of operations with a history that dates back more than 100 years in Canada

.

Are you looking for a new career opportunity? Join our team.

Application Deadline: September 10th, 2026

What we offer:

At EVR, we're dedicated to supporting our workforce on their unique career journeys.

EVR recognizes our employees' skills, competencies, and performance and offers opportunities with competitive compensation and benefits. We also aim to promote employee health and wellness and provide opportunities for professional development.

We believe in the power of diversity and strive each day to create a workplace where each individual is valued and respected for their contributions.

We also believe that our employees are the reason we are accomplishing great things and are committed to supporting them through our many different programs.

About the role:

Reporting to the Senior Engineering Supervisor, the Senior Mine Engineer is responsible for developing and optimizing strategic long-range plans to sustain and extend the Life of Mine at Greenhills Operations. The role involves executing all aspects of long-range planning including: pit, spoil and haul road design optimizations, life of mine schedules, strategic evaluations, all while considering potential impacts to sustainable development. This role also leads and supports key deliverables, including the Life of Asset, 5-year plan, budget, forecast and R&R, by collaborating with multidisciplinary teams and ensuring that deadlines are met. This role is an excellent opportunity for an engineer looking to make a positive impact on the business.

To be successful, we require a person who is self-motivated and enjoys working in a team environment with all levels of an organization. This person has strong written, verbal, and interpersonal communication skills and is dedicated to continuous improvement. They have proven problem solving skills and can organize competing priorities to enable effective decision making.

Join us in the breathtaking Elk Valley of British Columbia. Here you will find outdoor adventure at your fingertips. Whether it's biking and skiing, or the laid-back atmosphere of fishing and hiking, there is something for everyone! Working a compressed work week with alternating Fridays off, come experience what work life balance is all about!

Two Annual Bonus Plans

Comprehensive Benefits Plan

Retirement Package

Health Lifestyle Account

Relocation Assistance

Participate in and adhere to health and safety programs and policies

Lead and support key deliverables, including the Life of Asset, 5-year plan, budget, forecast

Mentor and develop skill set of the Long - Range Engineering Team

Execute on a wide range of mine planning including pit, spoil, haulage and closure design while considering potential sustainable development impacts

Perform iterative production scheduling from KPI analysis to estimated coal blending results

Influence strong site decision making through detailed data analysis and sound mining practices

Perform economic evaluations, long range capital consolidation, productivity analyses, strategic planning assessments, and peer reviews

Communicate mine development projects to the permitting groups within the business unit. Assist in developing mine permit applications and amendments and ensure mine plans are following permit compliance

Participate in the development of annual reserves and resource reporting

Bachelor of Science in Mining Engineering, or related field, or equivalent combination of education and experience

Registered P.Eng., or eligible to register, with Engineers and Geoscientists of British Columbia (EGBC); EVR will support eligible employees with their EGBC registration

Minimum seven years experience in mine planning

Proficiency in mine scheduling software such as XPAC Solutions, and mine design software such as MinePlan3D

Solid understanding of the Microsoft Office Suite®

Valid Class 5 Driver’s License or equivalent

jobs.description:
Location:
Apex Mine, St. George, Utah, USA

Department:
Special Projects

Reports To:
Special Projects Manager

Employment Type:
Full Time

Position Summary

The
Lead Geology Consultant
provides senior geological expertise across mine operations, resource development, technical studies, special projects, and due diligence activities. The role has primary responsibility for leading the underground Mine Geology function, ensuring effective grade control, geological data collection, production reconciliation, and technical support to safe and efficient mine operations.

The Lead Geology Consultant works closely with Mine Planning, Operations, Engineering, Survey, Resource Geology, Exploration, and Project Development teams to optimize resource extraction, support production objectives, and advance the Company's geological understanding and resource base.

This position also provides technical support to the

Special Projects team on resource growth initiatives, geological modelling, technical evaluations, drilling programs, project development, and other strategic initiatives as required.

Key Responsibilities

Mine Geology & Production Support

Lead, plan, coordinate, and oversee the underground Mine Geology function to safely achieve production and business objectives.

Provide geological expertise to mine planning, production, engineering, exploration, and project development activities.

Monitor mining activities and grade control to optimize ore extraction, minimize dilution and ore loss, and support production targets.

Oversee underground geological mapping, structural interpretation, face sampling, chip/channel sampling, and geological data collection.

Develop, implement, and continuously improve grade control, geological mapping, sampling, and QA/QC programs.

Analyze production geology data and complete monthly production reconciliations, identifying variances and opportunities for improvement.

Prepare technical reports, geological summaries, and recommendations for management and operational teams.

Geological Modelling & Resource Support

Support the Corporate Resource Geologist in preparing, maintaining, and updating geological and resource models.

Contribute to wireframing, grade control modelling, geological interpretation, resource estimation, and mine depletion tracking.

Ensure geological information generated from mining activities is accurately incorporated into geological models and resource databases.

Provide geological input into resource growth initiatives, technical studies, project development, and due diligence activities.

Review and interpret geological data to identify opportunities to improve resource confidence, mine planning, and resource extraction.

Drilling & Exploration Programs

Plan, coordinate, and supervise underground and surface diamond drilling programs.

Manage drilling contractors to ensure safe and efficient execution, adherence to scope and schedule, data quality, and budget requirements.

Coordinate geological logging, sampling, QA/QC, database management, and interpretation associated with drilling programs.

Review drilling results and provide geological interpretation and recommendations to support resource development and mine planning.

Track drilling expenditures and provide input into annual geological drilling budgets and forecasts.

Team Leadership & Development

Manage, mentor, and develop the geology team, promoting technical excellence, collaboration, accountability, and continuous improvement.

Establish clear priorities, work plans, and performance expectations for geological activities.

Foster a strong safety culture and ensure geological personnel and contractors work in accordance with company policies and procedures.

Provide coaching and technical guidance to geologists, geological technicians, and other geology personnel as required.

Special Projects & Corporate Support

Support the Special Projects team by providing geological expertise for project development, technical evaluations, resource growth initiatives, and due diligence activities.

Provide technical geological input to studies, business cases, project evaluations, and strategic initiatives.

Collaborate with corporate and site-based geology teams to ensure consistency in geological interpretation, data standards, modelling, and reporting.

Contribute to monthly, quarterly, and annual operational and technical reporting.

Provide geological expertise for other corporate or operational initiatives as required.

Budget, Data & Reporting

Assist with annual budgeting and forecasting for geological programs.

Monitor geological expenditures and support effective cost control.

Maintain oversight of geological drilling contractors, including scope, performance, safety, schedules, and costs.

Ensure geological databases, sampling records, geological logs, QA/QC information, and supporting documentation are accurate, current, and maintained in accordance with company standards.

Ensure geological information is appropriately documented and readily available to support operational and technical decision-making.

Health, Safety, Environment & Compliance

Promote and maintain a strong health and safety culture across all geological activities.

Ensure geological programs and activities comply with applicable health, safety, environmental, regulatory, and company requirements.

Identify and address geological and operational risks associated with mining activities.

Ensure contractors and geological personnel comply with required safety standards and procedures.

Continuous Improvement

Identify and implement opportunities to improve geological processes, systems, workflows, and data quality.

Evaluate new geological technologies, tools, and methodologies that may improve operational performance and resource understanding.

Promote the sharing of geological knowledge, lessons learned, and best practices across the organization.

jobs.description:
The Power of Now

Be part of something big. Fortescue is leading the world with our plan to decarbonise our iron ore operations, projects that harness renewable energy and the development of technology that will change our planet forever.

An opportunity has arisen for a Senior Engineer - Motorsport Analysis to join the Motorsport & Advanced Engineering department.

About the role

The 

motorsport and advanced engineering 

business unit have a team comprising of design engineers and engineering analysts. 

An engineering analyst is required to develop robust models and workflows to be used in simulation-led design optimisation activities.

 T

he ideal candidate has experience across thermal

,

 hydraulic and electrical systems. 

The project

s

are 

high performance in nature, with a focus on lightweight and powerful systems

 across motorsport, defence and other applications.

What you will do

As a member of the design and analysis engineering team your duties will include:

Responsible for simulation and data analysis across mechanical, electrical and thermal projects.  

Interrogate vehicle drive cycles, applying efficient data analysis techniques to identify potential errors, and define product requirements. 

Define multi-objective cost-functions to quantify performance, considering the full product and its application. 

Training machine learning models to optimise system design using large multi-parameter datasets.

Occasional event or test support, focussed on using data to support analysis methods.  

Coordinate focussed empirical component testing, collaborating with test and validation teams, to support simulation inputs and validation. 

Manage outsourced analysis work packages with specialist external suppliers

Must have high quality analysis experience in high performance applications such as motorsport, defence, aerospace. 

Significant exposure to HV systems, rotating machinery, power electronics, energy storage and low volume applications is highly desirable.

jobs.title: Managing Director - Power Systems
jobs.description:
The Power of Now

Fortescue Zero is at the forefront of advanced engineering and technology, developing high-voltage power systems, advanced battery software and electrification solutions for some of the world’s most demanding applications.

Our technology and engineering expertise extends across heavy industry, defence and elite motorsport, with involvement in global championships including Formula E, the IMSA and the World Endurance Championship.

An exciting opportunity has arisen for a Managing Director – Power Systems to join Fortescue Zero in Oxford.

About the Role

As Managing Director – Power Systems, you will lead the engineering, product development and programme delivery of our global power systems portfolio. Our technologies will support the electrification of some of the world’s largest mobile industrial equipment, with opportunities to expand into adjacent applications, including data centres.

Reporting to the Chief Technology Officer, you will have genuine end-to-end accountability across the product lifecycle, from concept and design through industrialisation, commissioning and customer acceptance. Supported by executive leadership, significant investment and dedicated resources, you will have a clear mandate to build capability, scale delivery and turn ambitious technology into safe, reliable and commercially successful products.

This is a rare opportunity to lead a multidisciplinary organisation at the forefront of industrial decarbonisation and shape products with the potential to change how industries operate.

What You Will Do

Lead and develop a high-performing multidisciplinary organisation across electrical, mechanical, systems, software, controls, product and programme management

Own the engineering, design and delivery of the power systems portfolio from concept through commissioning and customer acceptance

Set engineering standards, governance and technical assurance processes that deliver safe, reliable and scalable products

Ensure portfolio commitments are delivered safely, on time, within budget and to agreed quality and contractual requirements

Hold accountability for commercial and financial performance, including profitability, forecasting, cost control and resource planning

Establish disciplined programme governance, portfolio prioritisation, performance metrics and operating rhythms

Identify and manage technical, commercial, programme and customer risks across the full product lifecycle

Partner with Sales, Commercial and Finance teams on bids, pricing, contracts, change control and delivery risk

Build trusted executive relationships with customers, partners and stakeholders, acting as executive sponsor for major programmes

Translate Fortescue Zero’s technology and product strategy into executable plans that improve capability, scalability and business performance

About You

Significant executive leadership experience within a large engineering, product development or programme delivery organisation

Proven success leading multidisciplinary engineering teams through the full product lifecycle

Experience taking complex electrical, engineered or technology products from concept through industrialisation and into production

Strong commercial and financial capability, including profit and loss accountability, project profitability and contract management

Extensive programme management, portfolio governance and large-scale project delivery experience

Strong understanding of systems engineering, product development, technical governance and operational excellence

Experience delivering products or systems within mining, energy, industrial, heavy engineering or other demanding sectors

Demonstrated ability to combine engineering excellence, innovation and commercial delivery

Bachelor’s degree in electrical, mechanical, systems engineering or a related discipline

Experience working with original equipment manufacturers, engineering, procurement and construction contractors, mining companies or industrial customers will be highly regarded

About Us

Be part of something big. Fortescue is leading the world with our plan to decarbonise our iron ore operations, projects that harness renewable energy and the development of technology that will change our planet forever.

jobs.description:

Buscamos una persona responsable, organizada y con vocación de servicio, que se desenvuelva bien en campo, tenga capacidad de respuesta ante emergencias y pueda llevar un adecuado seguimiento de los procesos de Salud Ocupacional.
El reto
Asegurar la operación permanente del centro asistencial, brindando primera atención y soporte ante urgencias y emergencias, así como realizando el seguimiento operativo de las actividades de Salud Ocupacional de la unidad.

Brindar primeros auxilios, triaje, control de signos vitales y atención inicial ante urgencias y emergencias.
Realizar seguimiento a EMO, aptitudes, restricciones y recomendaciones médicas, escalando al médico los casos que requieran evaluación.
Mantener actualizados los registros e indicadores de Salud Ocupacional.
Verificar la disponibilidad de medicamentos, insumos, botiquines y equipos de primera respuesta.

Coordinar con SSOMA, Operaciones y el médico ocupacional las actividades y necesidades de la unidad.

Técnico(a) en Enfermería titulado(a) de un instituto autorizado.
Mínimo 2 años de experiencia general como Técnico(a) en Enfermería.
Mínimo 1 año de experiencia específica en Salud Ocupacional, tópico empresarial, industria, construcción, minería, emergencias o actividades asistenciales equivalentes.
Conocimientos en primeros auxilios y RCP/BLS vigente, atención de urgencias y emergencias y bioseguridad.
Manejo de Office/Excel.
Deseable experiencia en EMO, matrices de aptitud, seguimiento de restricciones y actividades de Salud Ocupacional.

Be part of something big. Fortescue is leading the world with our plan to decarbonise our iron ore operations, projects that harness renewable energy and the development of technology that will change our planet forever.

An opportunity has arisen for a Product Manager - Commercial to join the Product & Delivery department.

About the role

The
Commercial Product Manager
is a technically strong and commercially driven professional responsible for leading the
development, launch, and commercialisation
of products that accelerate the
electrification and decarbonisation of heavy industry
. This role combines strategic product leadership with deep technical understanding of
power electronics and energy systems
, ensuring Fortescue remains at the forefront of industrial sustainability and innovation.

Working collaboratively across
engineering, operations, and commercial functions
, the Commercial Product Manager will drive products from
concept through deployment
, delivering solutions that reduce emissions, enhance efficiency, and create long-term value for industrial customers. Embody Fortescue’s Values in all interactions.

What you will do

Product Strategy and Leadership
•    Define and execute the product strategy and roadmap for industrial electrification and power system solutions.
•    Translate customer, regulatory, and operational requirements into detailed Product Requirements Documents (PRDs) and actionable development priorities.
•    Ensure alignment of product initiatives with Fortescue’s sustainability, energy transition, and zero-emission strategy.
•    Manage the end-to-end product lifecycle — from concept and prototyping through validation, pilot deployment, commercial launch, and continuous improvement.

Technical and Cross-Functional Collaboration
•    Collaborate with Engineering, Innovation, and Manufacturing teams to guide product design, testing, and industrialisation.
•    Support technical feasibility assessments, manufacturing readiness reviews, and cost optimisation initiatives.
•    Ensure all products meet relevant industry standards, safety regulations, and certification requirements (IEC, IEEE, ISO, etc.).
•    Partner with Supply Chain and Procurement to evaluate suppliers, components, and technology partners for commercial viability.

Market, Customer, and Commercial Focus
•    Conduct market research and competitive analysis to identify trends, technology shifts, and partnership opportunities within industrial electrification.
•    Collaborate with Sales, Marketing, and Business Development to define go-to-market strategies, pricing, and customer value propositions.
•    Engage directly with customers to capture use cases, performance targets, and total cost of ownership (TCO) drivers for electrified systems.
•    Develop and maintain business cases, financial models, and ROI analyses to support product investment and portfolio decisions.

Performance and Continuous Improvement
•    Monitor product performance metrics, including adoption, reliability, and sustainability impact, providing insights to guide iteration.
•    Support operational readiness by coordinating cross-functional launch and lifecycle management activities.
•    Identify opportunities for product enhancement and portfolio growth based on customer feedback and market intelligence.

.

cross-functional project delivery

commercial and analytical skills

sectors.

electrical engineering, power systems, or industrial automation
.

preferred.

jobs.description:

Objetivo del cargo
Ejecutar levantamientos topográficos superficiales y capturas fotogramétricas de alta precisión mediante RPAS/Dron en el tajo y botaderos, validando la constructibilidad geométrica de las mallas de voladura y generando los ortomosaicos y modelos 3D necesarios para la conciliación de banquetas.
Principales responsabilidades
Validar el diseño geométrico de la voladura en terreno y medir con precisión milimétrica los resultados obtenidos post-disparo.
Obtener imágenes aéreas sistemáticas para la generación de ortomosaicos de alta resolución y modelos 3D en formatos OBJ y DXF.
Ejecutar el procesamiento de datos topográficos para los trabajos de conciliación de banquetas tanto para banco simple como para banco doble.
Ejecutar levantamientos topográficos de alta precisión antes y después de las actividades de perforación y voladura.

Ejecutar y procesar levantamientos fotogramétricos con UAV, generando ortomosaicos, modelos digitales del terreno y de superficie, nubes de puntos y modelos tridimensionales.
Preparar planos, perfiles, secciones e informes técnicos que respalden la evaluación del desempeño de las voladuras y el cumplimiento de los criterios de calidad del servicio QA/QC Wall Control.
Gestionar y resguardar la información topográfica y geoespacial generada durante el servicio.
Asegurar el cumplimiento de los estándares del Sistema de Gestión Integrado (ISO 9001, 14001, 45001).

Técnico Nivel Superior titulado en Topografía, Geomensura o Geominería.
Mínimo 3 años de experiencia en topografía superficial de minería a tajo abierto y fotogrametría digital.
Licencia y acreditación vigente de operador RPAS (Dron) emitida por la autoridad competente de Perú.
Manejo de equipos de precisión (GPS Diferencial, Estaciones Totales, Drones).

Proyecto de duración definida con posibilidad de extensión

jobs.title: Asistente de recursos humanos
jobs.description:
Buscamos Reclutador(a) de Personal Técnico

En RAM Equipos nos especializamos en reparación y mantenimiento de maquinaria pesada. Trabajamos con importantes contratistas mineros, empresas mineras, constructoras y compañías de los sectores automotriz e industrial.

Buscamos una persona dinámica, organizada y orientada a resultados, interesada en asumir un rol clave en nuestras operaciones y crecer profesionalmente dentro del área de Recursos Humanos.

El principal reto será asegurar la incorporación oportuna de técnicos mecánicos, electricistas, soldadores, supervisores y otros perfiles especializados.

Principales funciones:

• Gestionar integralmente los procesos de reclutamiento, selección y contratación, desde el levantamiento del perfil hasta la incorporación del candidato.

• Manejar simultáneamente entre 5 y 8 procesos, incluyendo coberturas rápidas y contrataciones temporales por días o semanas.

• Reclutar perfiles para los sectores de maquinaria pesada, minería, construcción, automotriz, industrial y metalmecánico.

• Publicar vacantes y buscar activamente candidatos mediante LinkedIn, Computrabajo, Bumeran, redes sociales, referidos y otras fuentes.

• Realizar filtros curriculares, entrevistas por competencias, validación de experiencia, referencias laborales y seguimiento de candidatos.

• Construir y mantener una base de datos actualizada de personal técnico disponible.

• Utilizar herramientas de inteligencia artificial para sourcing, identificación de candidatos y optimización de los procesos de selección.

• Coordinar con supervisores y responsables de cada área el avance y cierre de las posiciones.

• Gestionar el onboarding y offboarding del personal, incluyendo documentación, inducción, seguimiento inicial, encuestas de salida e identificación de oportunidades de mejora.

• Elaborar reportes e indicadores de reclutamiento, contratación, incorporación, rotación y salida de personal.

¿Qué perfil buscamos?

• Egresado(a), bachiller o profesional de Psicología, Administración, Recursos Humanos, Ingeniería Industrial o carreras afines.

• Experiencia mínima de 3 años en reclutamiento, selección y contratación de personal.

• Experiencia comprobable reclutando técnicos mecánicos, electricistas, soldadores, supervisores y otros perfiles técnicos u operativos.

• Experiencia en maquinaria pesada, minería, construcción, automotriz, industria, metalmecánica, mantenimiento o servicios técnicos.

jobs.title: Defence Security & Compliance Officer
jobs.description:
The Power of Now

Be part of something big. Fortescue is leading the world with our plan to decarbonise our iron ore operations, projects that harness renewable energy and the development of technology that will change our planet forever.

An opportunity has arisen for a Defence Security & Compliance Officer to join the Motorsport & Advanced Engineering. 

About the role

The Defence Security & Compliance Officer ensures the company adheres to strict regulations, such as export controls (e.g., ITAR/EAR), and manages security protocols for sensitive defence information and systems. Managing security vetting (BPSS), protect personnel and technical assets, and ensure compliance with UK Ministry of Defence (MOD) and customer standards

What you will do

Implementing Security Standards:
 Developing, implementing, and maintaining security policies, standards, and procedures across the organisation, aligned with Def-Stan 05-0138 and GovS 007

Security Assurance and Audit:
 Establishing and supporting security auditing, monitoring, and assessment capabilities to ensure data systems and business areas comply with legal and regulatory requirements (e.g., DPIAs, SyOPs)

Risk Management:
 Identifying, managing, and mitigating security risks, including those arising from third-party suppliers, delivery partners, and supply chains

Incident Response:
 Ensuring correct procedures and delegations are in place to respond to security incidents and breaches and assisting with investigations

Training and Awareness:
 Promoting best practices by developing training and engagement activities related to data protection and security

Leadership and Governance:
 Providing leadership on operational security matters, often involving cross-divisional collaboration

Key Skills and Experience

Regulatory Knowledge:
 Deep understanding of HMG security policies and standards (GovS 007 & Def-Stan 05-0138)

Technical Expertise:
 Knowledge of security auditing, risk assessment, and data protection mechanisms

Stakeholder Management:
 Ability to engage with various business areas and external suppliers

About you

Strong working knowledge of 
UK GovS 007
 and how it applies to a defence contractor environment 

Experience leading a security function covering 
personnel, physical, information and contract security

Confidence operating as a senior security point of contact with 
government and external agencies
and
reporting to the Senior Leadership Team

Ability to interpret and advise on 
emerging threats, geopolitical developments and defence sector risks

Experience delivering 
security training and awareness
, including inductions and briefings 

Experience planning and managing 
international visits

Strong leadership skills, with the ability to manage, develop and motivate

Demonstrated leadership potential alongside effective communication skills

Support Programme Management requirements and Business Development/Strategy requirements within the Defence sector

Must be able to achieve and maintain Base Line Security Clearance (BPSS) for this role.

Ability to travel outside the UK

What is in it for you?

Our UK benefits include:

Bonus scheme

Aviva Pension

Group Life Assurance

Group Income Protection

Electric Car Scheme

Health Cash Plan

Employee Assistance Programme

Private Medical Insurance

26 days holiday
plus
public holidays and the opportunity to purchase an additional 5 days per year

Childcare Benefits

Free on-site gym access and discounted national memberships

jobs.description:
Elk Valley Resources (EVR) operates four steelmaking coal mines that employ over 5,000 people in the Elk Valley of British Columbia. We are committed to responsible resource development, environmental performance and building strong partnerships with communities and Indigenous Peoples.

EVR is proud to be part of the Glencore Group, contributing to a global portfolio of operations with a history that dates back more than 100 years in Canada

.

Are you looking for a new career opportunity? Join our team.

Application Deadline: September 9, 2026

What we offer:

At EVR, we're dedicated to supporting our workforce on their unique career journeys.

EVR recognizes our employees' skills, competencies, and performance and offers opportunities with competitive compensation and benefits. We also aim to promote employee health and wellness and provide opportunities for professional development.

We believe in the power of diversity and strive each day to create a workplace where each individual is valued and respected for their contributions.

We also believe that our employees are the reason we are accomplishing great things and are committed to supporting them through our many different programs.

Reporting to the Superintendent, Process Maintenance, the Lead, Asset Condition is responsible for executing condition-based monitoring tasks and inspections on mobile equipment. The Lead, Asset Condition will analyse condition monitoring data, create work orders and communicate defects to the various maintenance teams to improve the effectiveness of current processes and increase equipment reliability.

To be successful, we are looking for someone with strong written communication and interpersonal skills, who is self-motivated and can collaborate with multiple teams of technical professionals. We require someone who is comfortable working from heights and in confined spaces. Lastly, we are looking for a person that is open and willing to take on new responsibilities and training opportunities to further develop your skills.

Join us in the breathtaking Elk Valley of British Columbia. Here you will find outdoor adventure at your fingertips. Whether it's biking and skiing, or the laid-back atmosphere of fishing and hiking, there is something for everyone! Working a compressed work week with alternating Fridays off, come experience what work life balance is all about!

Two Annual Bonus Plans

Comprehensive Benefits Plan

Retirement Package

Health Lifestyle Account

Relocation Assistance
